Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.

Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. subject: My opponent declared herself the leader of "White Women for Kamala Harris."
body:
Their plan isn't even secret anymore |
---

_"The work that we can do about winning back the House and the Senate is going to be on a number of things. For example, I believe that we need to expand the Supreme Court."

"...we should be pushing for statehood for Puerto Rico and D.C., right?
-Kamala Harris_
Fellow Patriot, take her at her word. We have 9 days to stop it.

This is what Democrats will do if they win the House and Senate.

_Pack the Supreme Court with liberal justices who will legislate from the bench._

_Add D.C. and Puerto Rico as the 51st and 52nd states to give Democrats extra seats in Congress._

_And you know they'll do whatever they can to bring back Roe v. Wade._

Hi there —
it’s Jocelyn.

Today, Donald Trump campaigned in Port Huron with my far-right opponent,
John James.

I’ll tell you more about what they said in a moment, but first I need you
to know this visit is a major warning sign. There’s no reason a sitting
President would fly out and campaign on behalf of my opponent this close

I thought of the parents of my son’s classmates who are trying to find new

I thought of the Michiganders who put their trust in my opponent in

These are the people I’m fighting for.

Look, I’ve defended Michigan from Donald Trump before, and I’m ready to do

When he tried to force me to hand over Michiganders’ private data, I said,
“No. I will see you in court.” And I won.

I will fight tooth and nail for Michiganders no matter who is in the White

name: Abdul
subject: I’m not sure what Mike Rogers would say if he were asked the same question
disclaimer_text: paid for by people like you
body:
Peter,
I know you hear from a lot of campaigns this time of year, so before I share something with you, I want to tell you up front why I'm writing.
There are just 9 days left until Election Day. Mike Rogers has MAGA Republicans in his corner, and they’ve committed over $100 million to flip this seat. I don't take corporate PAC money. That means every ad we run and every door we knock between now and November 3 is paid for by people like you.
A few weeks ago, I wrote a column for the _Lansing City Pulse_ about why I'm running. I want to share it with you, because it's the clearest answer I can give you about what your support is for.
But first, I have to ask: **can you chip in $5 or any amount to fuel our work? We’re counting on your support to spread the word about what our campaign is fighting for.**
[_**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-ms-aes-20261025-6-ak**_](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261025-6-ak.5cLwnz&amount=5&refcode=em20261025-3716&t=2&akid=3716%2E251025%2EHpjtrC)
* * *
**_I’m running because our kids are the whole point._**
At a recent town hall in Grand Rapids, a young boy asked me a question: _"What was the driving factor for you to run for Senator?"_
I didn't have to think twice. My answer was as simple as it was automatic: _**"You."**_
As a father, my "why" in this race has always been clear. Our kids are the whole point. In every child, I see my own children.
[](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261025-6-ak.5cLwnz&amount=5&refcode=em20261025-3716&t=3&akid=3716%2E251025%2EHpjtrC)
My brilliant daughters, Emmalee and Serene, are eight and three. I'm running for Senate because I want them to grow up in a world where they and all the children they're growing up with have a shot at the future they deserve.
But right now, our politics are keeping that out of reach. For far too long, billionaires and corporations have rigged the system against us all. Special interests buy and sell politicians while everyday Michiganders strain under record-breaking costs and stagnating wages. Utilities, insurance premiums, mortgages, gas and groceries — none of them are affordable alone. Together, they're pushing us to the brink.
**I'm running for Senate because in the richest, most powerful country in the world, it shouldn't be this hard to simply get by.** That's why I've never taken a dime of corporate money and never will. And on day one as Michigan's next Senator, I will champion legislation to overturn the catastrophic _Citizens United_ ruling to get corporate money out of our politics — so that we can finally build the world our children deserve.
I’m not sure what Mike Rogers would say if he were asked the same question. We may never know, because he doesn't do town halls where such questions are often asked. Considering the consequences of the full scope of his career, his honest answer would likely be the exact opposite: _"To make more money."_
We've seen what happens when Mike Rogers gets a taste of power. We've suffered through it before.
**Rogers spent twenty years in the state Senate and then in Congress abusing his office to enrich himself at the expense of Michiganders.**
He took money from Big Oil — then voted to keep gas prices high.
He took money from Wall Street — then voted for higher credit rates.
He took money from Big Pharma — then voted to gut Medicaid and raise prescription drug costs.
And upon leaving Congress, he spun through the revolving door to rake in millions by advising the very corporations he was supposed to regulate in office.
Mike Rogers has never met a billionaire or a corporation he wouldn't eagerly sell us out to. We know this to be true: **life gets harder for Michiganders when Mike Rogers is in charge.** Because, like his puppet master Trump, Rogers represents the worst in our politics.
As I've crisscrossed the state over the past year, I've had a chance to speak with voters of all backgrounds. We've held over 600 events in each corner of Michigan, and everywhere I go, I hear the same concerns. Trump is running wild in Washington without any checks or balances, and it has led us into a disastrous trade war with Canada as well as an immoral regime change in Iran. Mike Rogers has only cheered Trump's extreme policies, and, if elected, he'd rubber-stamp them without a second thought.
Folks can't afford their groceries. Gas is too expensive. Young people worry they'll never be able to hold a job or own a home, and healthcare access continues to be stripped away.
This November, we can do something about that.
**We can get money out of politics. We can put money in your pocket. And we can deliver Medicare for All.**
This election is a referendum on politics as usual.
We have a choice between a government that serves Michigan or a government that serves Donald Trump and the corporations from which he's enriching himself.
Michiganders, the choice is yours. Our children are counting on us.
* * *
Peter, that's the column. Here's the part I didn't have room to say in the paper.
I can't keep that promise to Emmalee and Serene, or to that kid in Grand Rapids, all on my own. Mike Rogers is banking on his corporate backers to carry him into the Senate. I'm counting on you.
**So please, contribute $5 or any amount today so that we can keep putting Mike Rogers's record in front of Michigan voters — on the air, at the doors, and at every town hall he won't show up to — through Election Day.**
[_**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-ms-aes-20261025-6-ak**_](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261025-6-ak.5cLwnz&amount=5&refcode=em20261025-3716&t=4&akid=3716%2E251025%2EHpjtrC)
Thank you so much,
Abdul

* * *
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Emails like this help us stay connected with grassroots supporters like you, so thank you for taking the time to read this message. To contribute via check, please address it to Abdul for U.S. Senate, PO Box 126, St. Clair Shores, MI 48080.

name: Roy Cooper
subject: Need your help
body:
We can’t miss this goal.
| | | | |
---
Peter, I’m sorry to reach out again – but I need your help.
With early voting in full swing, we’re running out of time to reach the voters we need to win. That's why we set a $500,000 goal to power our get-out-the-vote efforts in this final stretch, but right now, we’re falling short.
Missing this goal will mean putting our chances of flipping this seat at serious risk – especially since both President Trump and Vice President Vance were in North Carolina this past week and Trump promised to come back again next week!
I’m counting on you to not let that happen.
**Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can before the midnight deadline to help us close the gap, flip North Carolina and take back the Senate?**
**My team and I will be tracking donations at this link:**[**_https: //secure.actblue.com/donate_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1748&amount=5&t=2&akid=4965%2E124072%2ECVVoVz)

subject: Three days to help flood victims. Here’s where to drop off.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by [Hull for New Mexico](https://us
body:
We’re collecting food, water, new clothing, and more for families hit by the flooding.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/3Q8BWDjCOrZ?e=530e36cac1&c2id=62f28c177cd28b25da81790396be4810)
| |
# Three days to help flood victims. Here’s where to drop off.
---
|
---
| | | | | | Friend,
I have had the opportunity to tour any of the devastated areas of New Mexico and have seen and heard first-hand what their needs are. Families across New Mexico are dealing with the aftermath of the flooding. Some have lost their belongings. Some have lost their homes. All of them could use a hand from their neighbors right now.
That’s why the Hull for New Mexico campaign and the Republican Party of New Mexico are hosting a Flood Donation Drive this week, and I’m asking you to be part of it.
**When:** Monday, October 26 through Wednesday, October 28, 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. each day
**Where to drop off:**
RPNM Headquarters, 5150 San Francisco Rd NE, Ste A, Albuquerque, NM 87109
Gregg Hull Campaign Office, 2201 San Pedro Dr NE, Bldg 1, Ste 200, Albuquerque, NM 87110
**What’s needed:**
Canned food, bottled water, new clothing, new blankets, toiletries, and new toys for the kids
[**FOR MONETARY DONATIONS, VISIT REDCROSS.ORG**](https://us.list-manage.com/XSJytGtSTGI?e=530e36cac1&c2id=62f28c177cd28b25da81790396be4810).
You don’t have to bring a lot. A case of water or a bag of canned goods makes a real difference to a family starting over. If you can’t make it yourself, forward this to a friend, a coworker, or your church group who can.
This isn’t about politics. It’s about New Mexicans showing up for each other, the way we always have.
I hope to see you this week.
---
| | | | |
---
| |
**P.S.** Not sure what to bring? Water and canned food go the fastest. Drop off anytime between 10 AM and 4 PM, Monday through Wednesday.

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: Not everyone will be read in on our get out the vote plan
body:
So here’s the plan:
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Hi Peter, it’s Gina. I just got off the phone with my Organizing Director.
We went over our plan for these final days of early voting, and since you’ve been a dedicated supporter of our campaign, I wanted to read you in on the details of that conversation.
**Our organizing operation is in overdrive across every corner of Texas.** We’ve knocked on hundreds of thousands of doors, called and texted voters and volunteers, and built the kind of turnout machine this state hasn’t seen in years. Now it all comes down to one thing: getting our voters to the polls before early voting ends on October 30th.
I know my team and I come to you a lot to ask for money, and I by no means expect people to chip in every time I ask. **[But if you’re in a position to make a contribution today, it’d go a long way.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261025_4_ev.HxZY2-&refcode=em20261025-2545&amount=5&t=1&akid=2545%2E299639%2EDWUHxu)**
The success of our early vote push depends on a surge of support right now, while there’s still time to put those funds to work. Here’s why:
**Nearly every recent poll shows us within the margin of error against Greg Abbott.** This race will be close, and the votes we bank during early voting could be what decides it. Every supporter who votes now is one less voter we have to chase down on Election Day, and one step closer to finally having a governor who works for Texans.

# [The Power of The People!](https://bethfarnhamforcongress.com/2026/10/25/the-power-of-the-people/?jetpack_skip_subscription_popup)
---
By **Elizabeth Farnham** on October 25, 2026
---
| **District Round-up 10.25.26**
---
Dear Neighbor, Thank you for reading my District Round-up. As your candidate for Pennsylvania’s 13th Congressional District, it is my honor and pleasure to deliver to you where I’ve been and what issues I’ve tackled in the past week. Criss-crossing the counties of Adams, Franklin, Fulton, Bedford, Cambria, Blair, Huntingdon, Mifflin, Juniata, Perry, Cumberland, and Somerset gives me great opportunities to meet with voters, hear what is on your hearts and minds, and the chance to voice my fight for Everyday Americans. If you would like to contribute to my campaign, please donate here:**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/beth-farnham-for-congress-1](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=19a49a9d32d3fd81b1515de69cb34a8514e1ab4d5bbce7980ee20533e1f29616&blog_id=213069660&post_id=9416&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=dd9d0365e608228528231a81e1e51577&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2JldGgtZmFybmhhbS1mb3ItY29uZ3Jlc3MtMQ=&email_id=b695f9751256ec82c8c798fbdc0db2eb)**
---
| **Finding Our Power**
---
| |
---
The most POWERFUL thing we can do in this moment is darken an oval.
---
Not set fires.
---
Not hurt people.
---
VOTE for our DEMOCRACY.
---
Or you might not get to again.
---
Republicans in Congress are just fine with eliminating our rights:
---
to vote,
---
to have a system of checks and balances in our government,
---
to have agency over own bodies,
---
to afford our everyday essentials like gas in the tank, food on the table, healthcare, and housing,
---
to belong to unions,
---
to hold accountable those who violate human rights, Constitutional law, and international law.
---
But you can stop this chaos and the risk to our national security with A BLACK PEN.
---
When you finish, you won’t get a marching band.
---
You won’t get a glitter parade.
---
But you will have done the thing that will actually stop the current government that only operates through the whims of a corrupt and predatory racist and his treasonous bootlickers.
---
Vote for me, Beth Farnham, on November 3rd to save our country from fascism.
---
(But if you want to make a fist, go ahead and knock a door to convince others to VOTE! That’s the second most POWERFUL thing you can do! Call your local county Democratic committee to find out where.)
---
Together, we #ChooseDemocracy!
---
| Lovely Meet & Greet
---
| |
---
Many thanks to Robert and Mary Darling for hosting a lovely meet & greet in their home. It was a terrific time to meet new voters, especially those from different parties. The setting was vibrant, the energy fantastic as voters listened attentively and asked me questions about the issues near and dear to their hearts. Together, we #ChooseDemocracy!
---
| | |
---|---|---
---
| | **NOW Endorsement**
---
|
---
Do you know who ACTUALLY cares about women and girls?
---
The National Organization for Women (NOW)!
---
They fight for equal pay for equal work, racial justice, reproductive freedom, LGBTQIA+ rights, ending violence against women, and more!
---
And I am incredibly proud to be endorsed by them.
---
Who is not endorsed by them?
---
My opponent, an out-of-touch multimillionaire who voted against reauthorizing the Violence Against Women Act in 2021 and who’s just fine with rising maternal mortality rates in states that have severely restricted abortion rights.
---
Don’t fall for Republican claptrap claiming to care about women and girls.
---
They’re the party of child marriage, not releasing the entire Epstein files, and Vivek Ramaswamy’s horrendous ad supporting a victim’s rapist.
---
Vote for Democrats up and down the ballot, including me, Beth Farnham, on November 3rd, so we can create policies that ensure women’s bodily autonomy, equal pay, racial justice, and safety.
---
Together, we #ChooseDemocracy
---

| **A Level Playing Field**
---
|
---
Our U.S. Representative, an elitist, out-of-touch multimillionaire, is too cowardly to debate me, but [WJAC-TV News](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=1ef279e9cbb3f1e2c1ccc030111e2600f26a3dfbbe20d99d66c2fa5f6124a8c2&blog_id=213069660&post_id=9416&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=4fbc01b17c00af9b90f15e771135c256&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=b695f9751256ec82c8c798fbdc0db2eb) granted us a level platform in recording our interviews with their station. They asked each of us the exact same questions which I deeply appreciate the opportunity to answer and I did so by coming to Johnstown.
---
You can listen to our answers here:
---
Election 2026: John Joyce, Beth Farnham face questions in 6 News congressional interviews [**https://wjactv.com/.../election-2026-john-joyce-beth...**](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=79e24ce4ebda6ef4090c0500da93be195d05dfc2384b161919b1071d1a96ee30&blog_id=213069660&post_id=9416&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=75583b69bc07586eda19b4dfa2ed173d&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=b695f9751256ec82c8c798fbdc0db2eb)
---
If you’ve never heard from our U.S. Representative and wonder what he would actually say, I offer this link to our interviews.
---
Please vote for me, Beth Farnham, on November 3rd, so I can properly represent us Everyday Americans like the hard-working families and retirees on fixed incomes.
---
Together, we [#ChooseDemocracy](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=732bd7a7b5f639c1623bca9ba3e8e8711205a0df413c2b8cc0700d4fb5c93209&blog_id=213069660&post_id=9416&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=96852dddba3098e9c5d9eb5945a0ee8c&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_&email_id=b695f9751256ec82c8c798fbdc0db2eb)!
---
| **Courage for Democracy**
---
| |
---
Many thanks to Courage for Democracy for their support of my candidacy. It will take courage to impeach President Trump and Vice President Vance for their crimes against humanity and Constitutional Law, but I know we have the blessing of the Revolutionary Founders.
---
Why?
---
Because the Revolutionary Founders created the Impeachment process. They foresaw that sometimes the wrong person would be in office, whether they were elected there, appointed, or they changed for the worse over time.
---
The Impeachment process is the gift of non-violence from those who had sacrificed to found this nation of ours.
---
And if there is a Democratic majority and the President and Vice President are removed from power, then the Democratic Speaker of the House succeeds them and assumes the Presidency.
---
We must, however, find the courage to use this process, no matter how many times it has failed before.
---
“Courage looks good on Beth Farnham!
---
| |
---
Beth isn’t a career politician or a multimillionaire. She’s a mom, a former school board member, and someone who understands the challenges everyday Americans are facing.
---
She’s running for Congress in Pennsylvania’s 13th District to fight for affordable healthcare, reproductive freedom, public education, and a government that actually answers to the people.
---
And she’s not afraid to hold that government accountable.
---
Beth has pledged to support impeachment because defending the Constitution isn’t optional. It’s the job.
---
While too many in Congress are avoiding tough questions, Beth is showing up, holding town halls, and making herself accessible to the people she wants to represent.
---
That’s the kind of representation we need more of.
Pennsylvania’s 13th District, you’ve got a Courage Candidate on the ballot this November!
---
[#TeamCourage](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=f52b6df86751eb391cc62e848c19e7d07e6c41f721d9a78da7f57d840fc49de6&blog_id=213069660&post_id=9416&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=4dbbea5771e335fd57ab56e7655e82aa&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmFjZWJvb2suY29tL2hhc2h0YWcvdGVhbWNvdXJhZ2U/X190bl9fPSpOSypG&email_id=b695f9751256ec82c8c798fbdc0db2eb)[#CourageCandidate](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=883f4a882cdad0bf7d112068e65d44e89600f46c205e0f189c0b15825b5f65cc&blog_id=213069660&post_id=9416&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=9d402451167661bb918ae64b08cbedc2&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmFjZWJvb2suY29tL2hhc2h0YWcvY291cmFnZWNhbmRpZGF0ZT9fX3RuX189Kk5LKkY&email_id=b695f9751256ec82c8c798fbdc0db2eb)[#PA13](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=5ab479d71f6fa5fa1ea0a4cd00a8f408c20f4a827b23d178dc0730c36c87ebdf&blog_id=213069660&post_id=9416&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=ffb5a286841fc90b35dae8aa252f4a88&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmFjZWJvb2suY29tL2hhc2h0YWcvcGExMz9fX3RuX189Kk5LKkY&email_id=b695f9751256ec82c8c798fbdc0db2eb)[#Impeachment](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=55486798dac95723404ebdfa16f08645e6b7ea1e183f90b2d04b25e3caea304f&blog_id=213069660&post_id=9416&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=acc1f54a3773a17dedb363d5bbcfc354&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmFjZWJvb2suY29tL2hhc2h0YWcvaW1wZWFjaG1lbnQ/X190bl9fPSpOSypG&email_id=b695f9751256ec82c8c798fbdc0db2eb)[#Vote2026](http://bethfarnhamforcongress.com?action=user_content_redirect&uuid=bac36bbc73cf479cc9495d3014ff40fe4fd34b0588710da74844e3b47e7f58e8&blog_id=213069660&post_id=9416&user_id=248418217&subs_id=487468588&signature=97fe5099ca27b1d8c02f06e3a5e27e01&email_name=new-post&user_email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&encoded_url=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmFjZWJvb2suY29tL2hhc2h0YWcvdm90ZTIwMjY/X190bl9fPSpOSypG&email_id=b695f9751256ec82c8c798fbdc0db2eb)“
---
Together, we #ChooseDemocracy!
---
| **More Town Halls**
---
| |
---
Many thanks to the Perry County Democratic Committee for hosting their Town Hall on Thursday. Attendees came prepared with questions and fellow candidates Nate Wood for State Senate and Wendy Morgan for State House provided great answers to the State questions asked of them.
---
Thank you also to my terrific team of volunteers who made possible our Town Hall at the Juniata Brewing Company in Huntingdon County and our very last Town Hall at the McConnellsburg Volunteer Fire & Rescue Company in Fulton County today.
---
I appreciate everyone’s hard work to make these happen so that community members could share and get a taste of what could be. I not only would absolutely continue to hold public, in-person Town Halls throughout my term as U.S. Representative for Pennsylvania’s 13th Congressional District, I would sponsor legislation that compels other members of Congress to do the same.
---
Please vote for me, Beth Farnham, on November 3rd, so I can continue to listen to you.
---
Together, we #ChooseDemocracy!
---

| **Republicans Meet Beth**
---
Many, many thanks to Dave and Sunny Santa of Sunny Anna’s cafe in Johnstown who invited me to speak to voters at their cafe. I met many voters, especially of the Republican party, whom I enjoyed speaking and finding common ground with. Together, we #ChooseDemocracy!

If you would like to contribute to my campaign, please donate here: | Finding Our Power | | The most POWERFUL thing we can do in this moment is darken an oval. Not set fires. Not hurt people. VOTE for our DEMOCRACY. Or you might not get to again. Republicans in Congress are just fine with eliminating our rights: to vote, to have a system of checks and balances in our government, to have agency over own bodies, to afford our everyday essentials like gas in the tank, food on the table, healthcare, and housing, to belong to unions, to hold accountable those who violate human rights, Constitutional law, and international law. But you can stop this chaos and the risk to our national security with A BLACK PEN. When you finish, you won’t get a marching band. You won’t get a glitter parade. But you will have done the thing that will actually stop the current government that only operates through the whims of a corrupt and predatory racist and his treasonous bootlickers. Vote for me, Beth Farnham, on November 3rd to save our country from fascism. (But if you want to make a fist, go ahead and knock a door to convince others to VOTE! They foresaw that sometimes the wrong person would be in office, whether they were elected there, appointed, or they changed for the worse over time. The Impeachment process is the gift of non-violence from those who had sacrificed to found this nation of ours. And if there is a Democratic majority and the President and Vice President are removed from power, then the Democratic Speaker of the House succeeds them and assumes the Presidency. We must, however, find the courage to use this process, no matter how many times it has failed before. “Courage looks good on Beth Farnham! | | Beth isn’t a career politician or a multimillionaire. body:
We have a situation, Peter.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1731&source=&t=1&akid=4971%2E124072%2EAmmgvY) | | | |
---
Peter,
Here’s the situation: With just eight days until the election, our fundraising has taken a real dip at the worst possible time. We _have_ to get back on track to fund our final ads and keep up our momentum in the final week of this race.
**That’s why I’m switching things up. I’m lowering my fundraising ask to just $3 today. That’s right – just $3.**
[**_Will you chip in $3 right now to help us reach our fundraising goal, flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate for Democrats?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1731&t=8&akid=4971%2E124072%2EAmmgvY)
I know that $3 might feel small – but it’s not just your $3. When thousands of grassroots supporters chip in $3 or whatever they can, it adds up fast and builds the momentum we need to win.
$3 because North Carolina is the best chance for Democrats to flip a Republican-held Senate seat in the country.
$3 because if we lose here, we’ll lose our shot at taking back the majority.
$3 because GOP dark-money super PACs have invested millions into false attack ads against me.
$3 because we can make life better for working people, put an end to the chaos and stop President Trump’s cruel agenda – but only if we come together.
**I’m counting on you, Peter. We’re running out of time to fund our final ads of this campaign.[_Will you please chip in $3 to help us reach our fundraising goal so we can flip NC and the Senate?_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1731&t=9&akid=4971%2E124072%2EAmmgvY)**

body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=9775%2E582294%2EC523lf ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=9775%2E582294%2EC523lf ]Chris Pappas for Senate

In a moment [ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261026_1.POIdIu&refcode=em20261026-1&t=1003&akid=9775%2E582294%2EC523lf ]I’m going to ask you to donate $5 to my
campaign so we can win on November 3rd.

But first I want to answer a question someone recently asked me:

Is it too late to make a difference in New Hampshire’s election?

John Sununu, Donald Trump, and their Republican allies want you to think
so. They want us to decide it’s too late, to sit back and believe that
there’s no point in fighting during the final 8 days before the election.

Here’s the real answer: NO, it’s not too late to make a difference. In
fact it’s the perfect time to chip in to my campaign
for the first time.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261026_1.POIdIu&refcode=em20261026-1&t=1004&akid=9775%2E582294%2EC523lf ]So I’m asking you to chip in $5 to my campaign for
Senate right now.

Here’s how we’ll use it:

Your donation will help us ensure that every eligible voter makes their
voice heard. About 90% of voters in New Hampshire will vote on Election
Day, so everything we do in the next 8 days counts. Every dollar helps our
team reach more voters.

We’re scaling up our outreach now — and every decision we make about how
many people we can reach could be the difference between defending New
Hampshire and flipping the Senate or losing everything. If we don’t have
enough resources, we could lose.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261026_1.POIdIu&refcode=em20261026-1&t=1005&akid=9775%2E582294%2EC523lf ]With that in mind, will you please make
your first donation
to my campaign today? It’s not too late to keep New Hampshire blue.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261026_1.POIdIu&amount=5&refcode=em20261026-1&t=1024&akid=9775%2E582294%2EC523lf ]Donate $5 »

Thank you,

Chris Pappas

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.chrispappas.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=9775%2E582294%2EC523lf

| Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund Eddie needs your help... [](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNDEsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA7ytY_2Ul-cbQVsM0WrKqoQLe__SzKLC34uo87EPHD1Kl6R0dYEkAqlbgOBbaNdJnnvRXlpfCuHiGxXIZqVxZF1Q3Iok278Od_oy9w) | | | | | Dear Patriot, This is the photo of a good Christian man. A loving husband of almost 20 years, a supportive father of seven, and a dedicated law enforcement officer.
---
---
[](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNDEsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA7ytY_2VZhJNOOxlECx1hk7S38qi2OwDxRceLJo87Fpo4uKeqm2aF5MGivdn0iw0kC1jBeE5OFY-rwd6lVT1PVIIftIcG23XD_kffw)
---
I'm proud to call former Jal, New Mexico Police Officer Eddie Embly my husband... **[...and I'm urgently asking you to help keep him from spending the next decade in federal prison.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNDEsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA7ytY_2WBaals1l83s7T-GEd77Co-qAf48egWC69IV_bx49Noiv7KQbMledicqc9IRSJ8mKPlmk_N1ZtW5610CD5LmwLYg1jXncOpQ)** Please, allow me to explain... In July 2021, my husband responded to a call about a suspicious vehicle at a local truck stop. The driver was disoriented, sweating, unsteady, and acting erratically. Officers had to use a Taser to take him into custody. My husband had a limited role in the arrest - he helped move the suspect to the patrol car and transported him a short distance to the police station. Shortly after arriving at the station, the suspect became unresponsive and was pronounced dead. After investigating, the state medical examiner definitively ruled the cause of death as methamphetamine toxicity. So imagine our shock when over two years later, the Biden Department of Justice accused Eddie of "failing to intervene" and a "deliberate indifference to medical needs" - and charged him under a federal civil rights statute carrying up to 20 years in prison. We poured our life savings into Eddie's defense, expecting justice would prevail at trial and he'd soon be back on the job. But instead, the government blocked all evidence of the suspect's meth overdose from the trial. **The jury found Eddie GUILTY - and he faces up to 20 years in prison.** Now Eddie will miss graduations and birthdays. He won't get to walk our daughters down the aisle. And he'll miss the birth of future grandchildren. With nowhere to turn, I turned to God and prayed like I've never prayed before... And God answered our prayers - in the form of a phone call from Jason Johnson with the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). For the first time in months, I see a future with Eddie by my side enjoying our golden years. But LELDF doesn't receive taxpayer funding or grants, and large gifts are few and far between. Instead, LELDF relies on kind-hearted strangers who respect our men and women in blue and want to help cops like Eddie who are unjustly convicted. Folks, I pray, like you. **[Will you help LELDF fight for Eddie by making a tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100, or more today?](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwNDEsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA7ytY_2Xxg7m8d7QKXUmCYyZJLEUsubjOc3t7hGDqYWdXhL1p52sChLbPCwbhh3RAwXEbnYK9suYzva8nVUWzbZ4FhroiIrTfJWfYA)** No matter how much you're able to help, your donation will be put to immediate use, helping LELDF support Eddie and a dozen other wrongly accused officers. That's why I'm asking you to help LELDF fund Eddie's appeal by making an urgent donation today. The appeal will cost approximately $175,000 - **so whether you can give $35, $50, $100, $250, $500 or more - every gift will make a huge difference.** But no matter how much you're able to send in support of Eddie, please pray for us. I know firsthand the power of prayer. And I know with LELDF behind us and an army of prayer warriors beside us, Eddie will win his appeal and we can move on with our lives. From the very bottom of my heart, thank you. With God's blessings,
---
| | | Jennifer Embly
---

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | | "View in Browser" A Special Message from our Sponsor Please note that views expressed in this message do not necessarily reflect those of Free Speech Daily and do not constitute an endorsement or recommendation by Free Speech Daily . | Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund Eddie needs your help... | | | | | Dear Patriot, This is the photo of a good Christian man. A loving husband of almost 20 years, a supportive father of seven, and a dedicated law enforcement officer. I'm proud to call former Jal, New Mexico Police Officer Eddie Embly my husband... Please, allow me to explain... In July 2021, my husband responded to a call about a suspicious vehicle at a local truck stop. The driver was disoriented, sweating, unsteady, and acting erratically. Officers had to use a Taser to take him into custody. My husband had a limited role in the arrest - he helped move the suspect to the patrol car and transported him a short distance to the police station. Shortly after arriving at the station, the suspect became unresponsive and was pronounced dead. After investigating, the state medical examiner definitively ruled the cause of death as methamphetamine toxicity. So imagine our shock when over two years later, the Biden Department of Justice accused Eddie of "failing to intervene" and a "deliberate indifference to medical needs" - and charged him under a federal civil rights statute carrying up to 20 years in prison. We poured our life savings into Eddie's defense, expecting justice would prevail at trial and he'd soon be back on the job. But instead, the government blocked all evidence of the suspect's meth overdose from the trial. The jury found Eddie GUILTY - and he faces up to 20 years in prison. Now Eddie will miss graduations and birthdays. He won't get to walk our daughters down the aisle. And he'll miss the birth of future grandchildren. With nowhere to turn, I turned to God and prayed like I've never prayed before... And God answered our prayers - in the form of a phone call from Jason Johnson with the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). For the first time in months, I see a future with Eddie by my side enjoying our golden years. But LELDF doesn't receive taxpayer funding or grants, and large gifts are few and far between. Instead, LELDF relies on kind-hearted strangers who respect our men and women in blue and want to help cops like Eddie who are unjustly convicted. Folks, I pray, like you. No matter how much you're able to help, your donation will be put to immediate use, helping LELDF support Eddie and a dozen other wrongly accused officers. That's why I'm asking you to help LELDF fund Eddie's appeal by making an urgent donation today. The appeal will cost approximately $175,000 - so whether you can give $35, $50, $100, $250, $500 or more - every gift will make a huge difference. But no matter how much you're able to send in support of Eddie, please pray for us. I know firsthand the power of prayer. And I know with LELDF behind us and an army of prayer warriors beside us, Eddie will win his appeal and we can move on with our lives. From the very bottom of my heart, thank you. With God's blessings, | | | Jennifer Embly | | More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit www.leldf.org. And remember - Blue Lives Matter! | | | | ---|---|---|--- © Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | 2560 Huntington Ave. Suite 203, Alexandria, VA, 22303 |

body:

He’s stooped so low that even Republicans are calling him out. He’s showing Ohio exactly who he is: **a man willing to go to despicable lows to win.**
**But the fact of the matter is the polls still show this is anyone’s race.** Experts are calling our election _the most competitive governor’s race in the country, so even a few hundred votes could change things._
**[I’m urgently asking you to split a contribution between my campaign and Chris Pappas to help me fight back and win this election, not just for me, but for the people of Ohio. Even $3 can make a difference.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261026_2.INGOGA&refcode=em20261026-2&t=2&akid=9776%2E582294%2E3ZKpLO)**

I’m running to represent everyday families and make Michigan a place where everyone can live, stay, and thrive. But I can’t do it alone. This is one of the closest races in the country, and the first votes are being cast. We can’t afford to slow down now. I just made a very difficult decision in our budget meeting this morning,
and you deserve to know about it.

People like you have
invested so much in this movement, and I thought it was important to
explain my thinking.

In our meeting, it became clear that if we had a bit more money, we could
make a real play to turn out more people during early voting. Being more
aggressive now will put us in a much better position to flip this seat
next Tuesday.

Now is the time for big plays because, truthfully, the attacks from
Paxton’s super PACs are having a real impact. We had to move fast to close
the spending disparity with their dark money.

So I made the decision to spend more than we had planned. The money was
not in our budget, but I gave the green light because I worried that
without this investment we would lose.

Yes, it was a risk. But I took a leap of faith. I trusted that if I
explained the situation and my decision to you, enough people who believe

would come through to fill our budget gap.

Dream In the go-big-or-go-home collective consciousness of Texas, no
ambition is deemed too reckless, no daydream too wild. Save perhaps one.
It is the idea, fantastical to many as it is irresistible to others, that
the Democrats will win a statewide race in Texas for the first time in 32
years. According to the latest New York Times/Siena University poll of the
race for U.S. Senate, James Talarico, a 37-year-old state legislator seen
by national Democrats as one of the breakout stars of this cycle, is ahead
of his Republican rival, Ken Paxton, the state’s scandal-plagued attorney
general, by six points. The poll was conducted from Sept. 21 to Sept. 30.
A survey from mid-September, the ReconMR/Siena Research Institute poll,
also showed the Democratic gubernatorial candidate, Gina Hinojosa, four
points ahead of the three-term G.O.P. incumbent, Greg Abbott, the most
dominant political figure in Texas. Cue the fluttering heartbeats. Cue, as
well, the eye-rolls. Given how thoroughly Republicans have dominated the
state, and how the hopes of Democrats have repeatedly crashed, some Texas
pollsters remain skeptical. “At some point, you do get conditioned by all
that’s happened in the past,” said James Henson, the director of the
University of Texas at Austin’s Texas Politics Project. “I mean, you look
at the trends and you have to admit that something’s going on. But you
still don’t want to believe your lying eyes, because you’ve been burned
for so long.” Mr. Henson was referring to the perennial spectacle of
much-ballyhooed Texas Democratic aspirants face-planting against the Lone
Star State’s red wall. First came Tony Sanchez Jr., the swaggering and
self-funding Laredo oilman whom Gov. Rick Perry dispatched in 2002 by an
18-point margin. Next was the state senator Wendy Davis, who attracted
worldwide attention for her filibuster in the Texas Legislature against an
anti-abortion measure but whom Mr. Abbott demolished by 20 points in 2014.
Finally, the El Paso congressman Beto O’Rourke came up 2.6 points short of
defeating Senator Ted Cruz in 2018 but then suffered a 10-point loss to
Mr. Abbott four years later. Even with the awareness of such humiliations,
Democrats find themselves maintaining that 2026 could, at long last, be
the year. President Trump’s deep unpopularity and the prospect of a blue
wave could, they insist, extend into the state he won by nearly 14 points
in 2024. According to a September survey conducted by Texas Southern
University, Mr. Trump is seven points underwater in Texas. Mr. Talarico
has run an energetic and well-financed campaign, while Mr. Paxton has
staged far fewer public events and has had to rely on outside groups to
fund an attack-ad blitzkrieg against his Democratic opponent. Mr. Abbott,
meanwhile, has outspent Ms. Hinojosa by a 10-to-one ratio, yet has been
unable to build an insurmountable lead. “People have vastly underestimated
Gina,” said Ms. Davis, now a political consultant and a senior adviser to
Planned Parenthood Texas Votes, an advocacy organization. “Dollar for
dollar, she’s running the best statewide campaign we’ve ever seen.” Such
optimism stands in defiance of the political axiom that Texas is where
idealistic Democrats go to be mugged by reality. The party’s demise there
is not a product of ill fortune, Mr. Henson said. “Governor Abbott has
built an impressive election machine that has benefited state-level
Republicans again and again for a decade and a half,” he said. “And the
Democratic machinery here is almost nonexistent.” A ‘Hollowing-Out’ I have
written about the politics of my native state at regular intervals for
more than three decades. After watching the Democrats’ century-long rule
in Texas come to a decisive end with Gov. Ann Richards’s loss to George W.
Bush in 1994, I saw the party descend into atrophy in which failure begot
more failure. “The 30-year drought has done a lot of things,” said Luke
Warford, the chairman of the Travis County Democratic Party and the
founder of the Agave Democratic Infrastructure Fund. “It’s kept donors on
the sidelines, which makes a lot of potentially good candidates not run
because there’s no belief they can win. And it also makes a lot of really
talented staff leave to find better-paying work in true battleground
states.” The Democratic Party has no counterpart to Mr. Abbott, and hasn’t
since 1993, when Senator Lloyd Bentsen moved to Washington to join
President Bill Clinton’s cabinet. Its weaknesses are even more glaring
farther down the hierarchy. In recent elections, as many as one-third of
state races have gone uncontested by Democrats. One-fifth of the party’s
county chairs and two-thirds of its precinct chairs have been left
unfilled. Until last year, the state party had a negative operating
budget. As the veteran Democratic consultant Matt Angle observed, “There’s
been a hollowing-out of the party.” Still, those of us who recall the
satisfied sense of invincibility among Texas Democrats after roughly a
century of one-party rule have detected similar signs of overconfidence
among the state’s ruling party. The party’s rightward tilt, increasingly
forceful with each legislative session, reached its apotheosis in March,
with Mr. Paxton’s primary victory over the more moderate Republican
four-term incumbent, Senator John Cornyn. Mr. Paxton, a close ally of Mr.
Trump’s, was impeached by the Republican-controlled State House (and later
acquitted by the State Senate) in 2023 over allegations that included
bribery. He was also accused by his wife of adultery. Mr. Trump endorsed
him anyway, all but guaranteeing his landslide primary triumph over Mr.
Cornyn but in the process testing the allegiance of center-right Texans.
In similar fashion, the Texas G.O.P. is in danger of losing many Latino
voters who voted for Mr. Trump in 2024 after years of siding with
Democrats. “We adopted a lazy way of campaigning that bit us on the ass,
and we’ve learned from that,” Mr. O’Rourke said. “Now it’s the Republicans
who’ve gotten really lazy and complacent and comfortable.” Signs of
Republican Overreach Simply spending one week driving through the vastness
of Texas, as I did in September, is all it takes to appreciate an underdog
party’s uphill battle. The state’s 32 million residents are spread across
20 media markets, many of them distinct ecosystems, from the urban colossi
of Houston and the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex to the oil patch of the
Texas Panhandle to the Latino-dominated borderlands of the Rio Grande
Valley. “When national donors are deciding where to invest, they look at a
place like Iowa, where $5 million can fully fund a race,” said Katherine
Fischer, the director of the Texas Majority PAC, which was established by
the liberal philanthropist Soros family. “That’s why Texas is always at
the bottom of their list. It’s just so damned big.” Reaching so many
markets presents a daunting challenge for an upstart candidate like Ms.
Hinojosa, a state representative from the border city of Brownsville.
“There’s still 20 percent of the electorate that doesn’t know who I am,”
she said in an interview in mid-September. To date, Ms. Hinojosa’s
campaign has said that it has raised about $20 million. For his part, Mr.
Talarico spent about $30 million earlier this year to introduce himself
statewide as a man of Christian faith and a member of the Texas House with
a record of supporting bipartisan legislation. Since that time, however,
Mr. Paxton and his associates have invested more than $100 million in an
effort to redefine his opponent as “radical” and “weird,” with ads that
quote from remarks Mr. Talarico made several years ago (and later
renounced) suggesting that “God is nonbinary” and that there are six
biological sexes. Mr. Paxton and his allies have at times questioned Mr.
Talarico’s manhood and even his Christianity, an effort to jolt the
sensibilities of a state prone to mythologizing godly and masculine
archetypes. “How they’re negatively defining Talarico is kind of a
bank-shot way of saying that he’s not a true Texas conservative,” Mr.
Henson said. Whether money can overwhelm conditions on the ground is the
riddle looming over the Texas races. In the border city of Laredo, which
Mr. Trump won in 2024 — the first time a Republican had done so in over a
century — signs of buyer’s remorse are evident. Arrests by Immigration and
Customs Enforcement agents in Laredo were higher in July than in any other
American city. Mr. Trump’s erratic trade policies have further created
instability at the city’s port of entry. While acknowledging the economic
concerns that many border residents share, Adrian Zapata, a business
executive in the health industry who voted for Mr. Trump in 2024, said in
an interview that the negative ads against Mr. Talarico were resonating
with some of his family members. “They see Talarico as an ultraliberal,”
he said. “They’re done with the ‘they/them.’ They’re going to vote for
Paxton just because of that.” As for Mr. Zapata, “I’m not ready to vote
for Talarico,” he said. “But I don’t like Paxton. He’s never done anything
for South Texas, and his personal and business dealings have hurt him a
lot with folks down here.” There is a similarly muddled electoral picture
in the cattle country of deep West Texas adjacent to Big Bend National
Park. Mr. Trump and Mr. Abbott have aggressively championed a border wall
and artificial intelligence data centers, both of which threaten to
disrupt the region’s pastoral ethos. A coalition of more than 200
landowners has sued the federal government over the border wall, while
other residents have circulated a petition to protest the construction of
a new data center near Fort Stockton. George Johnson, a cattle feed
operator in Alpine, waved off such concerns, saying: “Folks worrying about
data centers were also worried when the internet got started. It’s
Talarico who scares me to death, him and all that socialist talk.” Others
in this largely conservative region harbor the view that Republicans have
failed to make good on their promises. Thaddeus Cleveland, the Republican
sheriff of Terrell County, said that both he and his county had voted for
Mr. Trump in 2024, but added, “Everything he campaigned on, we’re seeing
the opposite of, like going to war.” Sheriff Cleveland predicted that the
negative campaign ads by the Republicans would not factor as significantly
into the votes of his neighbors as “the price of groceries and gas, which
are compounded here because we’re so far from everywhere else.” But it is
in purple Tarrant County, dominated by Fort Worth, where the party could
pay the price for having potentially overestimated its mandate from the
voters. Conservative leaders have cut funds for nonprofits that aid
at-risk children, subjected school library books to right-wing litmus
tests and eliminated free bus rides to polling stations in poor
neighborhoods. “The far-right leaders here have implemented Project 2025
on a county level,” said Alisa Simmons, a Democrat and county commissioner
who is running to unseat the conservative county judge, Tim O’Hare. In an
early sign this year that area Republicans may be out of step with Tarrant
County’s constituents, a Democratic aviation machinist and union leader,
Taylor Rehmet, defeated Leigh Wambsganss, a well-funded Republican
Christian activist who led the conservative takeover of several metroplex
school boards. He won by 14 points in a January special election for a
State Senate seat covering a region that Mr. Trump won by 17 points in
2024. A ‘Gradualist’ Theory Which party prevails in Texas is a complicated
riddle. Historically a low-turnout state — it ranked second to last in the
2024 election, ahead of only Arkansas — Texas held a primary in March that
saw nearly one in four voters showing up to the polls, a modern record for
midterm participation, with Democrats slightly outpacing Republicans. A
few factors could conspire to thwart a blue wave in Texas. As of 2020,
straight-ticket voting is no longer possible in the state, which could
impact the mostly Democratic urban counties where that practice has
frequently been used by voters in past elections. Texas is one of only
eight states that lack universal online registration, while voting by mail
is also highly restricted. In January, Mr. Abbott turned over the state’s
list of approximately 18.7 million registered voters to the Trump
administration, and 1.2 million of them have subsequently been put on the
“suspense list” because their addresses have not been verified. The recent
shuttering of nearly one-third of Tarrant County’s polling sites by its
Republican-controlled county commission is particularly worrisome for
Democrats. “The reason we’ve lost these statewide races in the past is
because we’ve never gotten enough out of Tarrant County to overcome the
margins in rural Texas,” Ms. Davis said of the turnout. “If we don’t get
it to 53 or 54 percent this November, it’s game over. James and Gina can’t
win.” But the state’s Republicans have reasons of their own to be fretful.
Partly because of the recruitment efforts of the Texas Majority PAC and
Blueprint Texas, a down-ballot candidate support organization co-founded
by Ms. Davis earlier this year, the Democrats are fielding a full slate in
all 150 state races for the first time in a half-century. Though many of
these aspirants face long odds, their presence on the ballot could
energize the Democrats in predominantly conservative regions who have not
bothered to turn out in the past. “If we win on Nov. 3, most of those
names running down-ballot in really tough areas like East Texas and the
Hill Country and the Panhandle will be responsible,” Mr. O’Rourke said.
Mr. Henson added that while he remained skeptical about Democratic
enthusiasm being sufficient to carry the day for Mr. Talarico, he also
doubted that a last-minute avalanche of negative ads would prove decisive
for Mr. Paxton. “At a certain point, there’s diminishing impact once you
get past an absurd level of spending,” he said. Rather than project a
winner in November, Mr. Henson said he felt more comfortable embracing a
“gradualist” theory, one in which Texas does not become blue overnight,
but instead competitive. “Even if Talarico loses by a Beto-like margin,”
he said, “the next cycle is a presidential election, where Trump likely
won’t be popular and Democratic turnout will be higher. So there are
reasons for Texas Democrats to be optimistic.”'

Its weaknesses are even more glaring farther down the hierarchy. In recent elections, as many as one-third of state races have gone uncontested by Democrats. One-fifth of the party’s county chairs and two-thirds of its precinct chairs have been left unfilled. Until last year, the state party had a negative operating budget. As the veteran Democratic consultant Matt Angle observed, “There’s been a hollowing-out of the party.” Still, those of us who recall the satisfied sense of invincibility among Texas Democrats after roughly a century of one-party rule have detected similar signs of overconfidence among the state’s ruling party. The party’s rightward tilt, increasingly forceful with each legislative session, reached its apotheosis in March, with Mr. Paxton’s primary victory over the more moderate Republican four-term incumbent, Senator John Cornyn. Mr. Paxton, a close ally of Mr. Trump’s, was impeached by the Republican-controlled State House (and later acquitted by the State Senate) in 2023 over allegations that included bribery. He was also accused by his wife of adultery. Mr. Trump endorsed him anyway, all but guaranteeing his landslide primary triumph over Mr. Cornyn but in the process testing the allegiance of center-right Texans. In similar fashion, the Texas G.O.P. is in danger of losing many Latino voters who voted for Mr. Trump in 2024 after years of siding with Democrats. “We adopted a lazy way of campaigning that bit us on the ass, and we’ve learned from that,” Mr. O’Rourke said. “Now it’s the Republicans who’ve gotten really lazy and complacent and comfortable.” Signs of Republican Overreach Simply spending one week driving through the vastness of Texas, as I did in September, is all it takes to appreciate an underdog party’s uphill battle. name: Blaire Bartlett
subject: Brad Knott for Congress - Sign Up to Volunteer in the final stretch!
body:
Good morning from Team Knott!

We are reaching out because at some point you indicated interest in volunteering on the Brad Knott for Congress campaign.

We need some additional volunteers this week and leading up to Election Day, and we wanted to see if you had any interest.

Specifically we are looking for folks for the following activities:

1\. Monday, October 26th to Saturday, October 31st - poll greeters at early election sites in all 8 counties

2\. Monday, October 26th to Monday, November 2nd - door knocking in any of the 8 counties. Depending on day & time available and preferred county, we would link up to something already scheduled by the county chair or we would provide a list

3\. Tuesday, October 27th - deliver signs and palm cards to early voting sites in each county in NC-13 (Caswell, Person, Granville, Franklin, Wake, Johnston, Harnett, and Lee)

4\. Monday, November 2nd - deliver signs and palm cards to Election Day voting sites in each county in NC-13 (Caswell, Person, Granville, Franklin, Wake, Johnston, Harnett, and Lee)
5\. Tuesday, November 3rd - poll greeters at Election Day sites any time between 7:30 AM to 7:30 PM
Thank you in advance for your consideration. If you'd like to help, please respond with what you'd like to do and when, and I'll connect you with the team on the ground at the sites.

Many thanks - Blaire Bartlett
Brad Knott for Congress

\--

**Blaire Bartlett**
_Chief of Staff_
_[blaire@bradknottforcongress.com](mailto:blaire@bradknottforcongress.com)_
_202-821-2190 cell_

**Good Morning!** On this day in 1825, the Erie Canal opened after eight years of digging, and Gov. DeWitt Clinton set off from Buffalo aboard the _Seneca Chief_ on the first trip to New York City. A relay of cannons fired one after another along the 363-mile route, so the city heard the news in [about 90 minutes](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkbEO2zAMRL9G3hhYlCPbg4cu3tK1o8FIdKxGlgKJiZF-fZGsHTtw4R3u8HC_LsuFQgzp9pN2nmTNS-KjRhbhsuzPeie_B6lVqMSQ7u4p9PRhwRYt6BbQLuQkvHjRjZ9WZmTT8KT70bS67bFvtmk0nobVjc6Mw9mMmlF3w8DGemtaP3ITpk-c_p7B1p4s0-q5Y7KD0-hW1bXsg-Ry-p1Dko3X-M4vLieX9yZOm8ijKvND4axwPm7lz0dQOFOR4CIrnD9QCueYHUWF8zPdUz4SVMklcP33A3mFI71hywfIxsAlMDhKFCE_OIV0A8eF95zeENmD5K9tz6UyuOw_nb2GwXgz2HMHjNceuvNVA-nzFVaioUODtrd9Uyb_OEKModpede1tpxC_ZPJ_e7wm_BsAAP__MHKgNA). Scammers took $20 billion from Americans last year, and we want to tell you about the 10 most common scams that are putting you and your loved ones in danger right now. Odds are you've already encountered one or maybe even fallen into one. These deceptions are convincing enough to fool people who were sure they'd never fall for one, and knowing how they work is the best protection you have. So how do you keep yourself and the people you love safe? On today's episode of _Flyover Focus_ , we count down all 10, including one that threatens to drain your entire retirement account. [Tune in here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykj7FuwjAQQL8m2Yjss2vD4IEFiYEidWhHy9gXOOLEKL4E8fdV-YUOb3xPej8nfwqUabp-hhEd98VP-KwZmXH241KHkEbiWjnMmaYhLhyWRB4EmI0UGzA-RKYVvWyT6xEBVYtO2p0SUliw7c1FBWoLUWyDxij0TkqhdfrAiwjSWoCW3F9OvlEgTGcw9Ak1BrONEmLfaIGJuMzdvdDEN-zzq6w4d7GMbXY35kdt1L6BQwOHV1l46S7YwOF83A93ff5av4_t7NLjSTlTNbbR4joGym-f_3e9OvgNAAD__wH5a4s)! Are you paying more for car insurance than you need to? Later today, watch for a message from our partner, [Insurify](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L-O4yAQBvCnwZ0jAw4mBcVJkbu99kqLhSGZW_7kYHCUtz85unuCLab55qfR6Pv1sX1YjJhvP20CQ6FsGZ4tAhHULfX2ZX1Cao1sjZi_XCfbPW5iEmrk0yjUZh3hDhsfvAkAAuQAhi8XOfFpEctwN5_hosKn8kLp4OHiuVu8XiTXelGLln5Ac5zj75FiUicFNniYwSrtuHCBzRN4pFJPvwtmukOIr7JDPbmShmjuRI_G5A8mViZWzK1XDK9jycTa7A5MrH96IRhLCFDb2OZRHFiundLWSq8OmLxaer6xOlJn08PiLTN55bM-_0sTeOzpsJ3Kf1kyQSYmr_p8luI8yaEa_3hijNjUwubplizG97P0vYp3I_4GAAD__xXkkPQ), about comparing rates from more than 100 insurers in just minutes. Today's sponsor, [AutoCamp](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O3DAMhU9jdzPQj9eSCxUBFtNt2pQCV6JnmJVkQ6I8yO0DT4JcIAUbfg-PxPfjw38AJSr375DR8br5gs-WkBmrz719QczErTHUROUrdIYeySuh5osUFzV7CEwHejlGtyIq1CM6aRYtpDDKjA9nJvtpopWrCWjN9LksenmDSYDVi1ErjOTOOvkarcR8nRHWiBPCbINUYR0mgZF4q9efGxV-4Jp-bQfWa9jymNyDeW-D_jao26BuVA5sfIXOW4C8n5kT6Fvn7NvWa8BBv2MGSoOaz2XGSD0P-n0HipcdKhes7UH7X37WAN3LK_EPSisu-k37PxZ6IQY_WWmU0tpKM1YX9yelRG02wyTu58HXw_x_mg-nfgcAAP__jHSSsQ), is transforming the national park lodging experience with boutique accommodations near America's most iconic destinations, and now investors have a limited-time opportunity to be part of its growth.
|
---
## Musk Takes Credit for Starlink Curbs
Elon Musk said Saturday night that SpaceX deliberately [restricted Ukraine's Starlink service](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAMhp8GuqDEQDiKFNfQzbVXIk9iBt-EBCVhuH37FaPdJ9jCjW39-r_v722-IXsOjz-4kSlLnAOd2VMplObtyE90G5ecCybP4WmPgofjGSRooaQAPaMt_KJZ1c4sREBtTUYNYyuVHGCoVzOgRYV965ZBqXvXj9hrBdhD2462h75mc8Wp97QgdaMJF0cdof5lFdil6iQ5LjE1_yKHstLiP-KLUmPjVnuzlrLnqv1dwVTBdJ5nE-72wrju1yYm7yqYjmdCDlTBRD4GcdGJvKOl_8L6mMmJrw_xjSt8jPsaPQnPlwaxchEuxUAi2YBa9t3Y1cm4_WTvOeuh6uRjQ_bvauVnQl8GPgMAAP__ZPmN6Q) last week, accusing Kyiv's military of breaking the system's rules by using it for offensive drone strikes. _" That loophole was closed last week,"_ Musk [wrote on X](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFywyAQBNCvQZ09x6GAVFCkUee0KTUXOGxiJDziZCd_n7F_IcU2W7yZ3c_TfKJc8nr-oIW9pDqv_GiFRXibl71dKS5ZWhPaSl6vYRfaY54R0B40HNDOFCTfedZd9IkZ2XTstRsNaHDouotPUQ_8NYbBBbIOLBBgcmQthGRGA132T06_YhDs0TKlyD2THYLGkFQPHLPU7fhd8yoXTuW33nk7hrp0xV9Ebk2Zd4WTwunn2SqcuNT1OUDh1IRkbwon1LoHa8bBur5H9wZad5uPt0cuJTfrVA_nhXJ5wfK_O-4e_wIAAP__fftyaQ), calling his critics "bloodthirsty warmongers." When another user posted that "Zelensky needs to go," Musk replied, _" Yes."_ Ukrainian officials say the charge is impossible. Commercial Starlink doesn't work over Russian territory, and drone missions run only on Starshield, the military version that the U.S. government controls. A former defense ministry drone adviser said Ukraine "[did not violate the terms of use](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFvwyAQBeBfg7dE3EHADAxdvKVrR-tkjoQG25E5J-2_r5K_0OFJT2_4hvd1Hs9UalkunzRzlLyOCz9bZRHexnlvN0pzkdaEtlqW27QL7amMqNEdQB_QjTRJefAIXYqZGdl0HMEHo0F79N01Bkc5E_WQJ-OsTqANBH-y4WR6yAa7El8cvGNQu6Njyoktk-snwCkrqzkVWbfj91oWuXKuv-uDt-O0zl2NV5F7U-ZD4aBw-HmtCocmvC283NZ3J9mbwgEBrPamtyf0IQCE4Lotpvuz1Fqa88rqy0ylvmX53x-PiH8BAAD__4Ngclg)." The slowdown, which capped front-line connections at 100 mph for more than a week, [ended Saturday](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ8GOke24UwoXFxDl2uvRBu8hD2MjbwLEW9_Sl7hL6Ybjeb7_j7GB1Ck9PoDG3qZ85jwzRFFsIzbwSuEjYRZoERK63QIHIFGq61TRivrRpiEThxNHfyMaLGp0Zuub7TRne3qxbvZdL2B-9NNpruj6cPzF_Q9tNg64xpdk__MmW8aq93NIcwBWwR3n4yd5qrVGEhyuf3LlGTBOV75xHKb8lZHv4jsXDW_KztUdlgvOikF3DEFTPLpVHb4APBCGIPKOxYQyolVQZZcMCh45hNVq7VaN7WoYy1ACVkFnDExqo0SsZRLMVxc2aEuPuxvipHYdVWrXxtQ_N6Rn0k8vf0fAAD__2BGimU), two days after President Trump said Musk had agreed to "put it back." Musk warned that if Starlink were ever shut off, "the Ukrainian front line would collapse immediately."
## Audi To Build First US Plant in Georgia
President Trump announced Saturday that Audi will build its [first U.S. factory](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMGq2zAQRb9G3ilI48SOF16kFO9eN4UWujETeeRMnywFaRTz_r44v9DFMIsLh3vP74_5AzlwXH_gRqP4NEfaSyARyvNWyycuG0spgjlw_HRVsC48g4FOW6Ohm9EJv2i2zTJ6IqC2odH2Q2us6aFvHuO96_u7G4YLDXC1xjj0ix0Q-ov1lytcGx4PnH1fC6Y7dYR-oTNhd3UWnFdnQwtLyqe_iaM8yIev9KJ8cmlrwvgQeRbV3hRMCqZ9309biUemYKKoa1EwYZV0_JUiZQwKJsl1e2qMMdXoqOhjly7acy6i6UVZ16I9Okn5S3PUK6W8MmosWjCz90XfWehgZ327gf_z65xUOyXHi2q_fzuc0l5-Un42eVyeO4fApevV2awbcniXl_9T_hrhXwAAAP__NJGYyw) near Macon, Georgia, a roughly $4 billion plant that will turn out about 200,000 SUVs a year and employ about 4,500 people. Audi CEO Gernot Dollner joined Trump onstage at a [campaign rally](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAURb8Gb0TwSLE7MHTxlq4drRd42DTYRPCcKH9fOb_Q4U5Xulfn_FymC6actvkbV3Icy7TRs2Vipjqte7thWBO3xlhz2m5-Z9xDmkCBlVpJsBN6Tg-adBdcJAIyHTndfxqlVQ99tzhv0Ec0vQWFoD9sH9D64QpwHaJRQ-iSO-b0OwaUPVnCGOhMaAevwUdxVhQSl3r6LWnjhWJ-lQfVky9rl93CfG_CfAkYBYy80JJyPjoB41JWOogEjI2RST6R_SJgtLpX1ijJdV_vEret7JunJg88GdFzqS85U6lzQgFjV124P1POqdlenNW8Ynp_dPw_aw8HfwEAAP__pSWDQA) in Perry, Georgia, 10 days before the midterms. _" We are planning to bring our biggest and most premium SUVs, and produce them here in Macon,"_ he said. Production is slated to start in the early 2030s. The appearance drew fire at home. body:
All you need to do is RSVP, show up, laugh, and leave ready to flip seats.
#
Hi there,
Tonight’s the night! Some of America’s funniest comedians are teaming up with Swing Left for PORCH FRIGHT, a virtual evening of laughs, learning, and voter-mobilizing magic to help reach voters in these final 8 days before Election Day.
[](https://act.swingleft.org/go/3219?t=1&akid=3292%2E1562180%2E_mHG1q)
If the idea of talking with strangers about voting makes you a little nervous, you’re not alone. So we’re bringing in some people who know a thing or two about talking to strangers.
**Lisandra Vasquez, Maya May, Matthew Broussard, Irene Tu, Sasheer Zamata, Billy Eichner** , and a few surprise friends have turned talking to strangers into an art form. At this event, they’ll show you how to have positive conversations with voters, move past the awkward phase of talking to strangers, and how to make a voting plan.
You don’t need any experience to join us. Just show up, laugh, and leave ready to flip seats—because the most terrifying prospect of all is another two-plus years of unchecked Trump administration chaos.
[**Click here to RSVP now and join us tonight at 8 PM ET!**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/3219?t=2&akid=3292%2E1562180%2E_mHG1q)
**[RSVP Now »](https://act.swingleft.org/go/3219?t=3&akid=3292%2E1562180%2E_mHG1q)**

Derek, it’s Mikie Sherrill.
I was elected as the 57th Governor of New Jersey less than a year after Donald Trump took office for his second term. **Since then, I’ve made it my priority to lower costs for New Jerseyans and protect the working people in my state from the president’s destructive, corrupt, billionaire-first agenda.**

In November, Americans will have the opportunity to _finally_ put an end to Trump’s majorities in Washington, and elect leaders who are committed to delivering real progress for working people. **Derek, Election Day is _less than 8 days away_ , and this fight couldn’t be more important.**

name: Adam Hamilton (via DNC HQ)
subject: Not a politician
body:
If you believe our country needs new leadership, I hope you’ll read this message. [ ](https://ak.democrats.org/go/87341?t=1&akid=10061%2E22930333%2E44TfoZ)
---
| [](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-dnc-hamilton-split.95WOCh&amount=20&refcode=em_20261026_10061_fr&t=37&akid=10061%2E22930333%2E44TfoZ)
---
Hi, Derek,
From the start of this campaign, I have thought about why I made the decision to run for the U.S. Senate in Kansas.
I’m a husband, a father of two remarkable daughters, and a grandfather. I’m also the founding pastor of the largest United Methodist Church in the United States and a proud fifth-generation Kansan.
My great-great grandparents moved to Dickinson County, Kansas, 147 years ago. They were farmers and builders and good people who helped build their communities of Hope and Elmo. Like them, I love Kansas and its people, and I love my country. **That’s why I feel called to run for the U.S. Senate.**
Today, our nation’s highest values and aspirations are being undermined, and chaos and corruption in Washington is tearing Americans apart. We’ve insulted and alienated our allies. And we have a government in DC that’s making life harder for Kansans. People can’t afford the basics – food, gas and health care.
[**I’m running for the United States Senate because I care about our country, because things need to change, and because I know I can build bridges, bring people together to solve problems, and be a champion for Kansas. Can you chip in $20 split between my campaign and the DNC before the election in 8 days?**](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-dnc-hamilton-split.95WOCh&refcode=em_20261026_10061_fr&amount=20&t=38&akid=10061%2E22930333%2E44TfoZ)
I’ve heard from Kansans all over the state who voted for Roger Marshall six years ago and now feel he’s not listening to them. People who have met with him and often feel unseen or dismissed by the man they elected to represent them.
And now, this race has gotten close. Between political experts and polls, it’s clear we have a real chance to win here in Kansas and get to work for families.
I believe we can and must do more – and as the leader of a large, diverse congregation of roughly equal parts Democrats, Republicans and Independents, I am ready to disrupt partisan gridlock in Washington, bring people together and create meaningful solutions to our problems.
[**That work starts _now_ , and if you agree that what’s going on in our country is unacceptable, then I need you with me. Nothing about this race will be easy, and we’re going to need an incredible grassroots team to create change in Kansas and across the country. Please consider joining us now by making a $20 grassroots donation split between my campaign and the DNC to help support Democratic candidates up and down the ballot in Kansas and beyond.**](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-dnc-hamilton-split.95WOCh&refcode=em_20261026_10061_fr&amount=7&t=39&akid=10061%2E22930333%2E44TfoZ)

name: Roy Cooper
subject: I didn’t decide to run because it’d be easy
body:
I can’t break the GOP’s 18-year winning streak without you.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1760&source=&t=1&akid=4942%2E124072%2EerTj65) | | | |
---
Peter, I didn’t decide to run for U.S. Senate because it’d be easy. After all, President Trump won North Carolina all three times.
Now we’re being put to the test: President Trump has come to North Carolina _twice_ in the past month to rally his base around my MAGA opponent, and **he promised to visit again.**
Plus: At the eleventh hour, a super PAC tied to his campaign announced the launch of another seven figure ad buy full of lies statewide.
That’s because Senate control hinges on this battleground race – **and with just eight days left to go, the GOP is terrified.**
So if you’re ready to flip NC blue for the first time since 2008, I’d really appreciate you chipping in what you can today to help my campaign keep up this momentum across the finish line.
**Before I explain how we got here, you can use this link to donate:** [**_https: //secure.actblue.com/donate_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1760&amount=5&t=8&akid=4942%2E124072%2EerTj65)
Otherwise, please let me explain:
Serving as Governor was one of the great experiences of my life, but after my second term, I was ready to hang up my suit and tie. From adding hundreds of thousands of good-paying jobs to giving school teachers much-needed raises to expanding access to Medicaid, my #1 priority was to improve the lives of everyday people in my home state – **and we did that.**
That’s why it’s so upsetting to see how Washington DC insiders have turned their backs on hardworking people. DC insiders like Michael Whatley, my opponent in this race.
* He says he’ll lower costs, but built his career promoting the interests of Big Oil and utility companies at the expense of working families.
* He says he’ll protect our kids, but knowingly and repeatedly elevated a convicted child sex offender who did six years in prison to a position of senior leadership in the state GOP.
* He says he’ll put North Carolina first, but admits that the only reason he’s _“in this race is because Trump asked me to run.”_
While I did not enter this line of work with Washington DC in the cards, I couldn’t stand by as the GOP rips away health care access, guts resources for public education and chips away at the middle class. They aren’t making this country “great again” – they’re playing games with people’s lives.
So as one of the only elected officials in North Carolina with six statewide victories under my belt, I knew I had to get back in the fight. I’m so glad I did, Peter.
Since launch day, hundreds of thousands of folks like you have joined our grassroots movement for change, and momentum is on our side. Our job for the next eight days is to keep it that way.
North Carolina has a long history of Democrats polling ahead in U.S. Senate races all October, only to lose by the first Tuesday in November. I can’t break the streak without your help today.
[**_This race is going to come down to every last vote, so please, Peter: Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can today to keep our ads live, to keep our voter outreach going statewide and to keep us on track to victory in North Carolina?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1760&amount=5&t=9&akid=4942%2E124072%2EerTj65)
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1760&amount=5&t=10&akid=4942%2E124072%2EerTj65)
---
| | [DONATE $25](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1760&amount=25&t=11&akid=4942%2E124072%2EerTj65)
---
| | [DONATE $50](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1760&amount=50&t=12&akid=4942%2E124072%2EerTj65)
---
| | [OTHER AMOUNT](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1760&t=13&akid=4942%2E124072%2EerTj65)
---
Thanks for being on this team.
Roy Cooper
| |
* * *
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1760&t=2&akid=4942%2E124072%2EerTj65)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

[**_Donate today to help win this seat and flip the Senate blue._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1760&source=&t=3&akid=4942%2E124072%2EerTj65)

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: I’m not going to sugarcoat this.
body:
We were almost there. We can still win this.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter, I want to be straight with you, because you’ve earned that.
Back in April, I was down almost 7 points to Greg Abbott in the polling average. Political insiders wrote this race off. Then you showed up: you chipped in, spread the word, and proved that people all over the country believe Texas can be taken back. **By October 7, we had cut that gap to just 1.3 points.**
I know a lot of you saw that number and felt what I felt: _we can actually do this_.
But since then, the polls have moved in the wrong direction. Today, the average has me trailing Abbott by 2.4 points.
Here’s what I need you to hear: **2.4 points is not a lost race.** This is one of the most competitive governor’s races in the country, and it will be decided by turnout, by organizing, and by what we do in these final days.
Two weeks ago, we were closer to beating Greg Abbott than anyone thought possible. If we let up now, we could lose this race by a margin we could have closed. I need you in this fight with me. **[Can you chip in $15 today to help us get back to where we were and finish the job?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20261026_1_slipped.dFMi4S&refcode=em20261026-2532&t=2&akid=2532%2E299639%2EuzMutS)**
Early voting is already underway, and every dollar we raise right now goes straight into reaching the voters who will decide this thing. We can’t get comfortable. Not for a single day. **We have to make sure every voter hears the truth about Greg Abbott before they cast their ballot.**
Here’s just one example: yesterday, a watchdog investigation found that Abbott’s much-hyped “pause” on data center permits was never a pause at all. Dozens of projects kept moving forward. That’s Greg Abbott: a press release for voters, business as usual for his corporate allies.
**_Your donation could be the difference between winning and losing._** It could decide whether Texas gets four more years of Greg Abbott’s corruption or whether we take Texas back.
I’ve never needed your support more. **[Will you chip in $15 now so we can close this 2.4-point gap before Election Day?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20261026_1_slipped.dFMi4S&refcode=em20261026-2532&t=4&akid=2532%2E299639%2EuzMutS)**
[Donate »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20261026_1_slipped.dFMi4S&refcode=em20261026-2532&t=23&akid=2532%2E299639%2EuzMutS)
We closed a 7-point gap once already. Two points is within reach, but it’s now or never, and I need you with me today.
Thank you,
Gina
_Our records aren’t perfect – if you’ve donated with a different email address, phone number, or by check, not all of your gifts may be reflected in our accounting here. Our team greatly appreciates all of your support in electing me as the next Governor of Texas!_

subject: Your dollar goes further here than anywhere

body:
Our best chance to unseat Tim Burchett

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/7a903eee0d28/stand-up-against-the-shameful-gop-power-grab-7363982?e=dc5f639d62)

|

| |

Friend,
I know what it takes to campaign in Tennessee. Grit. Determination. Hope, amidst a chorus of naysayers who think that Tennessee is too red to flip. An unwavering belief that our community is worth fighting for.
I know that none of that comes as a surprise to you.
**But what might surprise you is how much further your dollar goes here in Tennessee.** It’s true.
Our media markets are smaller and ad buys are cheaper. Overconfident Republican incumbents (like Rep. Tim Burchett) don’t think they have to work that hard to defend their seats.
They don’t know how to run a modern campaign and earn votes because they don’t think they have to – so every mailer, postcard, and text sent, every door knocked, and every ad has a better chance of actually reaching a persuadable voter.
All of this means that every dollar goes further in Tennessee.
My friend, Michaela Barnett, has been running a phenomenal campaign to unseat Tim Burchett.
I’m so proud of what she and her team of supporters (me included!) have built over the past year plus: 1300 volunteers. 21 people on payroll. Thousands of doors knocked every week. Over 12,000 postcards sent. Over 220,000 voters already contacted – and a week and a half to ensure that every single supportive voter gets to the polls.

To keep running as hard as she has been this past year, Michaela needs to raise another $50k by election day. In another race, that would be a drop in the bucket of a multi-million dollar budget. **In this race, it makes all the difference.**
**Will you join me in chipping in to ensure Michaela has the resources she needs to beat Tim?**
[**CLICK HERE TO DONATE!**](https://us.list-manage.com/Ijx2GxRL2dK?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)****

In Solidarity,
Rep. Gloria Johnson

|
