Peter -We're entering the final stretch of this election, and one thing is becoming increasingly clear: **races across Nevada are incredibly close,** and the difference between victory and defeat could come down to just a handful of votes.**That's why I'm asking you to do three things today.**
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |

## 1\. MAKE A PLAN TO VOTE — AND DON'T WAIT UNTIL ELECTION DAY!
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
If you haven't voted yet, please make a plan to do so NOW.
Four years ago, historically bad weather hit Nevada on Election Day, keeping voters away from the polls and contributing to heartbreaking losses in races Republicans should have won.
We cannot afford to let that happen again.
There is simply too much at stake in this election.** From the Governor's Office to the State Treasurer's Office to Congress and the two ballot initiatives, the decisions Nevada voters make over the next eight days will shape our state's future for years to come.**
Early voting runs through Friday, October 30. Election Day is Tuesday, November 3.
**Please, don't leave your vote to chance. Vote early. Return your mail ballot. Make sure your voice is heard.**
---
| |

## **2\. HELP MAKE SURE YOUR FRIENDS AND FAMILY VOTE, TOO.**
---
| |
Once you've voted, don't stop there!
Reach out to your friends, family, coworkers, and neighbors. Ask them if they've voted. Encourage them to make a plan. Offer to [**help them find their polling location**](https://us.list-manage.com/LUx2yhXDH0g?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d) or drop off their ballot for them.
Nevada elections are often decided by razor-thin margins.
**Your encouragement could be the reason someone casts the deciding vote in a close race.**
---
| |

## **3\. HELP US RAISE THE FINAL $3,150 WE NEED TO REACH VOTERS.**
---
| |
We're so close to the finish line, and we have one final hurdle to clear.
We need just $3,150 to fund our final round of voter outreach text messages.
These messages will help us reach voters in the final days of the campaign, remind them what's at stake, and encourage them to get to the polls before it's too late.
**Can you chip in $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can afford to help us close this gap?**
---
| [DONATE NOW — HELP US RAISE THE FINAL $1,750](https://us.list-manage.com/j0913HNUwwE?e=817ed65ac7&c2id=d5ba536a36ebcb17f684b24f2e31274d)
---
| |
My team and I have worked too hard and come too far to leave anything on the table now.
I'm incredibly grateful for your support throughout this campaign. With just days remaining, I'm asking you to help us finish strong.
Vote early. Get your friends and family to vote. And if you can, help us reach those last voters who could make all the difference.
Let's win this!Drew

body:
|

Friend, We wanted to give you a quick update from the team on Derek’s first ad of the general election, “Many Lives.” It tells voters who Derek is: the son of refugees, an Army veteran, and a congressman who’s been fighting for working families in this district since day one. **[Watch “Many Lives” here, then chip in $3 to help keep it running through November 3rd.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142232684/656232860/-1308493735?refcode=em-10.26.26-all-1-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGJkOWU5ODctNjhkMS1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjlmODY5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=kw0PMaXGuaVMRgl5g4ReVU0QvfHvnqWfToBOX9xCrOo=)** | **[Keep our ads up](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142232685/656232861/439559405?refcode=em-10.26.26-all-1-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGJkOWU5ODctNjhkMS1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjlmODY5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=kw0PMaXGuaVMRgl5g4ReVU0QvfHvnqWfToBOX9xCrOo=)**
---
Here’s the part most people don’t see. An ad doesn’t stay up just because it launched. It stays up because there’s money to keep it running the next week, and the week after that. With almost 1 week until Election Day, we’re funding it until the last ballot is cast.
Meanwhile, national Republicans have made it clear they want this seat back. If our ad comes down, Derek’s story stops reaching the voters who are deciding right now, while their ballots are sitting on the kitchen table, waiting to be filled out.
We can’t keep Derek’s story on the air without grassroots supporters like you. That’s why we’re asking:
**[Can you chip in $3 to keep “Many Lives” in front of CA-45 voters through Election Day?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142232686/656232862/439559405?refcode=em-10.26.26-all-1-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGJkOWU5ODctNjhkMS1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjlmODY5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=kw0PMaXGuaVMRgl5g4ReVU0QvfHvnqWfToBOX9xCrOo=)**

I didn't cry until the very end of _[NAZA](https://substack.com/redirect/1ba115b6-ee36-475f-9d5e-57d589890a85?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_. The new documentary, by Academy Award-winning Israeli filmmakers Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, is all about Israel's ongoing assault on Gaza. But it's only in the film's final minutes that we get a direct view of the suffering on the ground there--a bombed building, a screaming crowd, and then a close-up of a man searching desperately through the debris. He's shouting over and over, "Sa'id, my love, it's Daddy. Sa'id, my love, it's Daddy," until he collapses, sobbing in the rubble that buried his child.
Sa'id was a "NAZA," the Israel Defense Forces' acronym for collateral damage: the number of civilian deaths--adults and children--that Israel deemed acceptable for every Hamas operative it eliminated ("Hamas operative" meaning anyone Israel's AI targeting systems identify as being in some way connected to Hamas). After 80 minutes listening to Israeli officers describe strikes with 15 approved NAZA, 20, 100, even an instance of a 500-NAZA strike, to be confronted with the desperate, hopeless agony that is one single NAZA--that is the murder of this man's beloved child--is as big a cinematic gut punch as any I've experienced.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=4981170&post_id=222096682&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjIyMDk2NjgyLCJpYXQiOjE3OTMwMzg1ODcsImV4cCI6MTc5NTYzMDU4NywiaXNzIjoicHViLTQ5ODExNzAiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.32FbL_pZdhPqIMAKax3IY8cr6hjfwGuLfivzg9U6ys4)
The searing emotion of this finale is a sharp tonal break from _NAZA_ 's preceding scenes, which are composed of nighttime interviews with 24 Israeli intelligence officers. The core of each interview is an often quite clinical description of the systems these soldiers used--and may be still using--to target and kill Palestinians. Though of course the Israeli government has gone on offense to [label](https://substack.com/redirect/1fb7eae4-3d2b-4eb7-9cfd-d14b4213560f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) _NAZA_ "distorted, misleading, and disingenuous"--with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu [threatening](https://substack.com/redirect/5c98d8fb-b12f-49d4-a4be-4c7512ed4961?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to revoke the directors' Israeli citizenship--the film is remarkably straight in its presentation. Abraham, who conducts each interview, is shown on-screen; we hear his questions and how he sometimes pushes back on his interviewees' answers. We also see how an interview was interrupted by an air raid siren, a regular fixture of life for Israelis. Though the cinematography is effective, there is no filmmaking magic or trickery here, no moments that a reasonable person could describe as propaganda. Just 24 Israelis explaining from their own firsthand experience how they helped kill thousands of unarmed men, women, and children in Gaza.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/08c8e046-39ee-441f-80b8-d7ec9799f03b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Director Yuval Abraham interviewing a subject of _NAZA_ on a rooftop in Tel Aviv.
Much of _NAZA_ 's run time focuses on descriptions of two related AI surveillance and targeting systems used by many of the interviewees. The first, named [Lavender](https://substack.com/redirect/913e2f61-ec0c-46ba-967d-6c49b40c7af1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), identifies Hamas operatives--or, more accurately, the phones of Hamas operatives--through their behavior. So if someone calls another person whom the system has identified as related to Hamas, they're awarded a certain number of points; if they go to a location the system has identified as related to Hamas, they get more points. Once the person has enough points, they're automatically added to Israel's kill list. "It's a perfect job for machine learning," noted one officer who helped develop the program. "Looking at characteristics, making a determination. Is it a cat or a dog?" Lavender allowed Israel to unleash "targeted" attacks at scale. "Efficiently, like in a factory," said an interviewee--attacks directed not just against senior Hamas officials but people "so junior we didn't know who they were." It was, said another officer, about "quantity, not quality." Of course, as anyone who's encountered a large language model hallucination knows, AI regularly makes mistakes. And this was factored in too. As one officer explained, Israel operated with an understanding that its Lavender kill list had a 10 percent-15 percent error rate.
The second system, nicknamed "[Where's Daddy](https://substack.com/redirect/a0004427-20fd-4624-b7df-b2d3ae9253ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)?" identifies the right time to bomb a target. The right location is already decided--Israel's protocol, the officers explain, is to strike targets in their homes. To determine whether the person is actually at their home, Where's Daddy? monitors their family (again through their cell phones), searching in particular for children asking their mothers when their fathers would be home--hence the program's name. One officer described monitoring a 12-year-old girl and then calling in a strike, saying, "You hack her phone and then you kill her." Another remembered hearing a baby crying in the background before he signaled for an attack. In a third conversation, an officer described looking through the photographs saved on a target's phone to help identify the best angle of attack on the man's apartment. He recounted seeing a picture of the target with his young daughter, then listening in real time to the family's screams as the girl was burned alive.
How many times have we heard defenders of Israel try to [pin the blame](https://substack.com/redirect/c3f1a3b1-fae4-495a-b1d7-ec075fee790c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for the disproportionate carnage in Gaza on Hamas's use of human shields? _You can 't blame Israel for killing so many civilians when Hamas hides its military targets behind civilian infrastructure_, the line goes. And all the while, the Israeli military has been making a conscious decision to attack its targets at night, after they return to their crowded residential apartment blocks. As one interviewee said, "There are only so many military sites in Gaza. But there are lots of private homes." The human shields argument never actually relieved Israel of culpability for its slaughter of tens of thousands of Palestinians. But it certainly tried. Like so many other defenses of the indefensible, it was, from the very beginning, a willfully immoral delusion.
Israel can utilize killing systems like Lavender and Where's Daddy? because it controls all telecommunications in Gaza. An officer described being able to listen in through any cell phone's microphone or look out through any cell phone's camera. "You feel like God," he said. What the subjects of _NAZA_ are describing is a new era of warfare, based on mass surveillance and AI decision-making, that should never have been allowed to escape the realm of dystopian sci-fi. Now that this computerized barbarity has seeped out into our real world, we'd be fools to think the contagion won't spread.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..AnYo2KtYvG0OLuUaoReo6xqz7b-EhDagobi7t0Wyc60?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=222096682)
This is where, as grounded as _NAZA_ is in Israel and Gaza, the lessons of the film extend out far beyond the specific atrocities it chronicles. Palestine has always been a testing ground for the West's newest security systems. Some of Israel's strongest American supporters are quite explicit about this--in a recent debate, Republican Congressman David Valadao defended his support for military aid for Israel, [saying](https://substack.com/redirect/3204bb87-7401-477e-aa43-21032a7836ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "The fact that those weapons are used there and tested there, we are able to learn from that and use that experience to develop our weapons systems to help us." When you add together Flock, Palantir, NSA surveillance, and the development of a class of oligarchs who, like the Israeli officer peering into a victim's phone, "feel like God," as they control our government and invest in [luxury bunkers](https://substack.com/redirect/dbb5dbf0-c345-4994-a49f-527f89b0c756?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and talk openly of [Armageddon](https://substack.com/redirect/50c753ae-559e-4f3e-aea0-eec274fce99e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), it is not hard to see _NAZA_ as prefigurative: a warning of what the entire world can become--_will_ become--if we don't take action now to stamp out this nightmare vision.
Of course, for the Palestinians who remain trapped in Gaza, this isn't a possible dystopian future--it's their lived reality today. These people are the victims of this nightmare.
Still, the nightmare is leaving deep marks on the Israelis executing and implementing it too--effects we see laid bare in this documentary. Watching _NAZA_ as a Jew, it is hard not to grieve over the ways that nationalism, fear, and hate have shaped the attitudes of too many in our community.
How else to describe some of these quotes by _NAZA_ interviewees--some describing their own feelings and some describing the broader views of their society--which I jotted down as best as I could in the movie theater:
> There are no innocent people in Gaza.
> Whatever we do to them, they deserve it.
> I'd carry out strikes and then go out with my friends.
> Dogs would eat the bodies. I didn't like to watch. But people around me would watch the dogs eat the bodies.
> It's so insanely fun. Like a video game. You enjoy completing your mission.
> There was talk of bringing in psychologists to see us, but there was no need. Not one person raised any doubts.
Many of the officers were themselves grieving what they had done:
> Yes, it's a genocide. Completely. Even if you say it's NAZA, it's intentional. We intended to kill those children.
> I never understood how the Germans could do it. Today, I understand it. I still see those Nazis as evil. But what does that make me?
This is the ultimate question underlying _NAZA_. The Holocaust and Israel's genocide in Gaza are different in many ways--scale, context, rationale, historical era. But the systems creating these atrocities, and the mindsets that allow them, share obvious similarities. No one in _NAZA_ ever actually says the words, "I was just following orders." But many equivalent justifications--"I was a small cog"; "If I hadn't done it, someone else would have"; "It's not my role to say something"--can be heard throughout.
Ultimately, whatever historical comparisons one might draw, the most salient fact about the destruction of Gaza is that it is ongoing to this day. The survivors in Gaza, in addition to experiencing hell on earth--as Israel [continues](https://substack.com/redirect/b9fe6f48-a699-45fb-80ee-8047f01902b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) restricting aid and squeezing them into an increasingly small and dangerously overcrowded area--are still being [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/0ac3eb94-bb09-4f46-a238-07e18cd6eb4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) every single day. At [least 30](https://substack.com/redirect/d0c77f59-de43-4a67-9730-8b78a490b646?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) men, women, and children were murdered just this past week, and over the [last year](https://substack.com/redirect/c8e7e5ff-ea14-45ae-84e0-f793386a0b53?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Israel has injured more than 5,000 Gazans and killed nearly 1,500, including more than 300 children--all during an ostensible ceasefire. Just last Wednesday, an Israeli airstrike hit a family's apartment in Gaza City, [killing](https://substack.com/redirect/94938247-5676-44df-9c8a-78176ea2e9d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a 33-year-old-mother; video footage from inside the apartment shows her young daughter watching as her mother was consumed by flames.
There are people--many people--who still deny this reality. _NAZA_ won't change their minds. After justifying apartheid, famine, and genocide, it seems simple enough to write off a documentary--even one made by Israeli filmmakers, featuring Israeli military officers--as nothing more than anti-Israel or even antisemitic lies. But hopefully there are some previously quiet people out there whom _NAZA_ can influence--people who can be inspired to begin speaking out against these crimes. Israelis who, like Abraham and Szor, feel nauseated by what their government and military have been doing. Americans who don't want to keep paying for these atrocities with their taxes. Jews who are sick and tired of seeing children killed in their name. In some ways, we have all served as small cogs in this nightmare system. Likewise, we all have a role to play in dismantling it.

Sa'id was a "NAZA," the Israel Defense Forces' acronym for collateral damage: the number of civilian deaths--adults and children--that Israel deemed acceptable for every Hamas operative it eliminated ("Hamas operative" meaning anyone Israel's AI targeting systems identify as being in some way connected to Hamas). After 80 minutes listening to Israeli officers describe strikes with 15 approved NAZA, 20, 100, even an instance of a 500-NAZA strike, to be confronted with the desperate, hopeless agony that is one single NAZA--that is the murder of this man's beloved child--is as big a cinematic gut punch as any I've experienced. The searing emotion of this finale is a sharp tonal break from NAZA 's preceding scenes, which are composed of nighttime interviews with 24 Israeli intelligence officers. The core of each interview is an often quite clinical description of the systems these soldiers used--and may be still using--to target and kill Palestinians. Though of course the Israeli government has gone on offense to NAZA "distorted, misleading, and disingenuous"--with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to revoke the directors' Israeli citizenship--the film is remarkably straight in its presentation. Abraham, who conducts each interview, is shown on-screen; we hear his questions and how he sometimes pushes back on his interviewees' answers. We also see how an interview was interrupted by an air raid siren, a regular fixture of life for Israelis. Though the cinematography is effective, there is no filmmaking magic or trickery here, no moments that a reasonable person could describe as propaganda. Just 24 Israelis explaining from their own firsthand experience how they helped kill thousands of unarmed men, women, and children in Gaza. | | ---|---|--- Director Yuval Abraham interviewing a subject of NAZA on a rooftop in Tel Aviv. Much of NAZA 's run time focuses on descriptions of two related AI surveillance and targeting systems used by many of the interviewees. The first, named , identifies Hamas operatives--or, more accurately, the phones of Hamas operatives--through their behavior. So if someone calls another person whom the system has identified as related to Hamas, they're awarded a certain number of points; if they go to a location the system has identified as related to Hamas, they get more points. Once the person has enough points, they're automatically added to Israel's kill list. "It's a perfect job for machine learning," noted one officer who helped develop the program. "Looking at characteristics, making a determination. Is it a cat or a dog?" Lavender allowed Israel to unleash "targeted" attacks at scale. "Efficiently, like in a factory," said an interviewee--attacks directed not just against senior Hamas officials but people "so junior we didn't know who they were." It was, said another officer, about "quantity, not quality." Of course, as anyone who's encountered a large language model hallucination knows, AI regularly makes mistakes. And this was factored in too. As one officer explained, Israel operated with an understanding that its Lavender kill list had a 10 percent-15 percent error rate. The second system, nicknamed "?" identifies the right time to bomb a target. The right location is already decided--Israel's protocol, the officers explain, is to strike targets in their homes. To determine whether the person is actually at their home, Where's Daddy? monitors their family (again through their cell phones), searching in particular for children asking their mothers when their fathers would be home--hence the program's name. One officer described monitoring a 12-year-old girl and then calling in a strike, saying, "You hack her phone and then you kill her." Another remembered hearing a baby crying in the background before he signaled for an attack. In a third conversation, an officer described looking through the photographs saved on a target's phone to help identify the best angle of attack on the man's apartment. He recounted seeing a picture of the target with his young daughter, then listening in real time to the family's screams as the girl was burned alive. How many times have we heard defenders of Israel try to for the disproportionate carnage in Gaza on Hamas's use of human shields? You can 't blame Israel for killing so many civilians when Hamas hides its military targets behind civilian infrastructure, the line goes. And all the while, the Israeli military has been making a conscious decision to attack its targets at night, after they return to their crowded residential apartment blocks. As one interviewee said, "There are only so many military sites in Gaza. But there are lots of private homes." The human shields argument never actually relieved Israel of culpability for its slaughter of tens of thousands of Palestinians. But it certainly tried. Like so many other defenses of the indefensible, it was, from the very beginning, a willfully immoral delusion. Israel can utilize killing systems like Lavender and Where's Daddy? because it controls all telecommunications in Gaza. An officer described being able to listen in through any cell phone's microphone or look out through any cell phone's camera. "You feel like God," he said. What the subjects of NAZA are describing is a new era of warfare, based on mass surveillance and AI decision-making, that should never have been allowed to escape the realm of dystopian sci-fi. Now that this computerized barbarity has seeped out into our real world, we'd be fools to think the contagion won't spread. This is where, as grounded as NAZA is in Israel and Gaza, the lessons of the film extend out far beyond the specific atrocities it chronicles. Palestine has always been a testing ground for the West's newest security systems. Some of Israel's strongest American supporters are quite explicit about this--in a recent debate, Republican Congressman David Valadao defended his support for military aid for Israel, , "The fact that those weapons are used there and tested there, we are able to learn from that and use that experience to develop our weapons systems to help us." When you add together Flock, Palantir, NSA surveillance, and the development of a class of oligarchs who, like the Israeli officer peering into a victim's phone, "feel like God," as they control our government and invest in and talk openly of , it is not hard to see NAZA as prefigurative: a warning of what the entire world can become--will become--if we don't take action now to stamp out this nightmare vision. Of course, for the Palestinians who remain trapped in Gaza, this isn't a possible dystopian future--it's their lived reality today. These people are the victims of this nightmare. Still, the nightmare is leaving deep marks on the Israelis executing and implementing it too--effects we see laid bare in this documentary. Watching NAZA as a Jew, it is hard not to grieve over the ways that nationalism, fear, and hate have shaped the attitudes of too many in our community. How else to describe some of these quotes by NAZA interviewees--some describing their own feelings and some describing the broader views of their society--which I jotted down as best as I could in the movie theater: There are no innocent people in Gaza. Whatever we do to them, they deserve it. I'd carry out strikes and then go out with my friends. Dogs would eat the bodies. I didn't like to watch. But people around me would watch the dogs eat the bodies. It's so insanely fun. Like a video game. You enjoy completing your mission. There was talk of bringing in psychologists to see us, but there was no need. Not one person raised any doubts. Many of the officers were themselves grieving what they had done: Yes, it's a genocide. Completely. Even if you say it's NAZA, it's intentional. We intended to kill those children. I never understood how the Germans could do it. Today, I understand it. I still see those Nazis as evil. But what does that make me? This is the ultimate question underlying NAZA. The Holocaust and Israel's genocide in Gaza are different in many ways--scale, context, rationale, historical era. But the systems creating these atrocities, and the mindsets that allow them, share obvious similarities. No one in NAZA ever actually says the words, "I was just following orders." But many equivalent justifications--"I was a small cog"; "If I hadn't done it, someone else would have"; "It's not my role to say something"--can be heard throughout. Ultimately, whatever historical comparisons one might draw, the most salient fact about the destruction of Gaza is that it is ongoing to this day. The survivors in Gaza, in addition to experiencing hell on earth--as Israel restricting aid and squeezing them into an increasingly small and dangerously overcrowded area--are still being every single day. At men, women, and children were murdered just this past week, and over the , Israel has injured more than 5,000 Gazans and killed nearly 1,500, including more than 300 children--all during an ostensible ceasefire. Just last Wednesday, an Israeli airstrike hit a family's apartment in Gaza City, a 33-year-old-mother; video footage from inside the apartment shows her young daughter watching as her mother was consumed by flames. There are people--many people--who still deny this reality. NAZA won't change their minds. After justifying apartheid, famine, and genocide, it seems simple enough to write off a documentary--even one made by Israeli filmmakers, featuring Israeli military officers--as nothing more than anti-Israel or even antisemitic lies. But hopefully there are some previously quiet people out there whom NAZA can influence--people who can be inspired to begin speaking out against these crimes. Israelis who, like Abraham and Szor, feel nauseated by what their government and military have been doing. Americans who don't want to keep paying for these atrocities with their taxes. Jews who are sick and tired of seeing children killed in their name. In some ways, we have all served as small cogs in this nightmare system. Likewise, we all have a role to play in dismantling it. | | ---|---|--- This review was published by . They rock, check 'em out! P.S. This piece is obviously a downer. But there's a lot to celebrate today. Last night, when I heard the results of the election in Brazil, I literally broke into tears of joy. I'll share my reactions through posts. Here's how I was feeling after the first round of Brazilian voting on October 5th, when the far-right Flavio Bolsonaro came in first. | | ---|---|--- And here was my reaction last night, when Brazil's leftist president Lula--who, among other wins, has achieved a historic decrease in deforestation of the Amazon--came back to comfortably win the runoff. | | ---|---|--- Worth repeating here: Fuck the fascists. that](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMWczx673yNBW7Xyf9HQ7ZpCpKlKpZMkSet_u2ttgr8mH6XAb-yi0S2JlgYVDA0bpCpSKTbp4865UZiN1T-jujmFZdoWIXCuaaGl41OYChYiH66zIEWKhuzadAv1ZQjLYP1Pv8FB5SETHoMjo9i17CxVnrQq8O1RYtMsENImiMdP7cbxKKYcP6_BhjEqTK6neNh9UOV9I8zY-o9ssQgVlUZzDCu78Fq1SXW_SE2thMYLVa9eTEfMunxBxea6nEanHxc5uIbJ_2CeuyWWahGahjFrlJm0ykL2f0DANSOm-tS31lImsNPPFToI7cZI0bClifBRDAXJqDR0VbGtZa-uQMoDhhdGpAr19zt0IGogbyhKsAD_sgCf18kx6Kmd9mH7XAyEtMhKzRvbaMs2z4z3gwtPXgU_zu0SEeJEnDyMhi8K-jpBrQIyChCLYLt8nqpkQuOHXu801TzoFjD3k9KjOWh1KSk-4nXEaLu7S9m-SWWhqGXp8nQMSXmV3KAMtzSmuwg/4v7/BlsYyeVaTySd8s3TXK7ukA/h4/h001.du5HzJCqj7hs73gIXkOyGNZneoB26wHX7uUf98lsP6o). Because apparently, nobody on his team is.** That’s because Trump has surrounded himself with an army of ass-kissers and yes-men/women who shield him from bad news, negative polls, and the reality of just how unpopular he is. He really might believe his own bullshit. Because it’s what he _**wants**_ to believe. It’s much easier than facing the reality that he may go down as the worst president in American history. (Sorry, James Buchanan. You’ve been displaced, and it’s not even close.) body:

| [](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._xQH0BeoZkye64UVA)
---
Peter, I don’t like receiving these emails as much as the next guy, but with Election Day less than 15 days away and America’s future on the line, I’m left without a choice.
I spent a lot of time writing this, so please read each word carefully.
It’s Kellyanne Conway: I’m a pollster by trade, so I can sniff out phony polls from a mile away. When I saw these numbers, it had me genuinely worried:
---
| VIRGINIA’S 2ND CONGRESSIONAL DISTRICT POLLING
---
JEN KIGGANS (R) | ELAINE LURIA (D)
47%| 47%
| [HELP JEN PULL AHEAD](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.)
---
VA-02 is one of the REAL toss-up races in America, and the decision you make today could have a massive impact this November.
Losing Jen Kiggans would spell disaster for our Conservative House Majority and our country.
Jen is a Navy Veteran who flew H-46 and H-3 helicopters and completed two deployments to the Persian Gulf. After her service, Jen became a board-certified Nurse Practitioner and continued to serve in long-term care and nursing facilities in Virginia Beach and Norfolk. Her entire life has been dedicated to service.
---
[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.)
---
Jen got in this fight because she saw how Democrats and Joe Biden crippled America with their far-left policies and knew she had to get involved. She made a massive leap of faith in 2022, when she flipped a blue seat red and immediately got to work.
Now, the same Democrat Jen ousted in 2022 is back for revenge – and her opponent has the backing of the entire Democrat Establishment and their money machine.
With the rise of the DSA and socialists, I’m extremely worried if Democrats win this seat. If they do, they will be even closer to flipping the House, and will immediately move to:

* Gut border security and open the southern border back up
* Defund ICE
* Raise our taxes
* Usher in DEI in our schools, military, and at every level of government
* Impeach President Trump

Peter, we cannot rest on our laurels for another second. [I’m launching a 24-hour fundraising blitz to help Jen reach her MOST important goal of the year and propel her to victory.](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.)
---
| [MAGA BLITZ ACTIVATED](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.-TA)
---
| [GIVE ANY AMOUNT](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.)
---
We have a real chance here at tipping the scales back in our favor, but it requires every Conservative reading this to step up and do their part.
I hope I can count on you today.
Talk soon,
Kellyanne Conway
---
---
[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._DTcXakumydyL3Tg)
---
I would not be where I am today without the help of my incredible and faithful supporters like you. Because of your support, I can keep fighting to make our country stronger.

Together we will get our country back on the right track and secure America’s success!

If you're reading this, you understand that TX-15 is going to be one of the hardest House seats in the country to win this November, and one of the most important.
**[That's why I'm humbly asking: is flipping the #1 tossup seat in the country worth $5 to you?](https://substack.com/redirect/e3957089-b915-4554-ac69-f6c7ba8ea8a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Here's what I've had on my mind lately:
Victory isn't a given. Trump won this district by 18 points in 2024, and together we've turned it into a true toss-up. That means we're doing something right.
But this isn't in the bag until the last vote is cast on November 3rd.
Republicans have booked more money against me than almost any House candidate in the country. Trump's super PACs alone are spending over $5 million to drag us down.
**Early voting is underway right now in Texas, and every day that passes is a day we lose to reach voters before they cast their ballots.**
So you have a choice in this race: help us score the biggest upset of 2026 in a seat Republicans gerrymandered to be unwinnable, or let Trump drown us out on the airwaves.
I seriously can't win this race without you.
**[So if this race is worth even a few dollars to you, this is the moment to make those $5 count. Please chip in today to help us flip the South Texas seat that will decide control of Congress:](https://substack.com/redirect/e3957089-b915-4554-ac69-f6c7ba8ea8a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

| | | | Peter, I have been fighting the National Firearms Act for **most of my adult life.** Last week, a federal court _finally_ told the government it cannot keep the registry. _Let me explain what happened, because the headline does not do it justice_ _..._ Since 1934, the NFA has forced Americans to register suppressors and short-barreled rifles, and the entire scheme rested on a $200 tax. When Congress eliminated that tax, it left the registration behind, and in doing so, **it knocked the constitutional legs out from under its****OWN****law!****** We took that argument into the Northern District of Texas in _Jensen v. ATF_ , and the judge AGREED with us. Now, here is the part I want you to understand clearly. SAF put the financial muscle behind that case. Our sister organization, the **Citizens Committee for the Right to Keep and Bear Arms** , carried it as a named plaintiff, and the court order in _Jensen_ reaches CCRKBA members across the country, current and future. clean_body: A note from SAF founder Alan M. Gottlieb. | | | | | | | Untitled Document A note from SAF founder Alan M. Gottlieb. | | | | | Peter, I have been fighting the National Firearms Act for most of my adult life. Last week, a federal court finally told the government it cannot keep the registry. Let me explain what happened, because the headline does not do it justice ... Since 1934, the NFA has forced Americans to register suppressors and short-barreled rifles, and the entire scheme rested on a $200 tax. When Congress eliminated that tax, it left the registration behind, and in doing so, it knocked the constitutional legs out from under itsOWNlaw!** We took that argument into the Northern District of Texas in Jensen v. ATF , and the judge AGREED with us. Now, here is the part I want you to understand clearly. SAF put the financial muscle behind that case. Our sister organization, the Citizens Committee for the Right to Keep and Bear Arms , carried it as a named plaintiff, and the court order in Jensen reaches CCRKBA members across the country, current and future. So we are doing something we have NEVER DONE BEFORE! | Two organizations. Two sets of tools.Two membershi ps . ONE donation ! An opportunity like this may never happen again! I will not pretend the fight is finished. We have two more NFA challenges in the courts, rulings get appealed, and the anti-gun lobby is already hunting for a way around this one. But this is the best opening we have had in nearly a century, so you need to ACT NOW! I would rather have you inside this fight than reading about it.** Standing with you, Alan M. Friend, when it comes to putting Vladimir Putin before American values and security, Donald Trump’s betrayal knows no bounds.
Trump recently announced a shocking deal with Putin to purchase and distribute diesel fuel. He’s trying to sell this dangerous scheme to the American public with a bald-faced lie: claiming it will lower skyrocketing diesel prices for our truckers, farmers, and working families here at home.
This is completely false.

Energy experts and market analysts agree that the limited amount of Russian diesel in this deal will do virtually nothing to lower prices at the pump. What it will do is throw Vladimir Putin a multi-billion-dollar economic lifeline.
By unilaterally waiving American sanctions, Trump is lining Putin’s pockets with fresh capital to continue his murderous, unprovoked war of aggression against Ukraine. Trump is turning his back on brave Ukrainians fighting for their lives, weakening NATO, and destroying decades of American moral leadership on the world stage.
**That is why I led a bipartisan group of 12 Senate colleagues – six Democrats and six Republicans – demanding that Donald Trump immediately rescind this disastrous Russian diesel deal.**
Putin is a ruthless tyrant. America should not be providing a war criminal with a financial gift while he slaughters innocent civilians and targets Ukraine’s energy grid.

subject: The final stretch of this campaign
body:
|
#
Friend, With just eight days to go until Election Day, here’s a _quick update_ on what’s been happening in this race. The good news is that Kristen is coming into the crucial final stretch with a wave of grassroots momentum on her side. The calls, the mailers, the ads on the air, and the conversations with mid-Michiganders right on their front porches – they're all adding up. **Now for the _bad news..._** National Republicans have already poured millions into this race in a desperate attempt to flip MI-08. That’s because they know this seat could decide control of the House this fall, and protecting it is one of the clearest paths to a Democratic majority. Friend, a lot is riding on this race. subject: TAKE ACTION: Tell the EPA to protect us from power plant pollution
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTQwNTU2NjIS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjU2MDEzOTk4MwS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Tell the EPA: We Need Protections From Power Plant Pollution!

Trump’s EPA is tearing down limits on carbon pollution from power plants — the
second-largest source of climate pollution in the country.

The Trump administration is abandoning the EPA’s core mission to protect human
health and the environment, and ignoring science. This latest attack on critical
safeguards against dirty power plant pollution endangers communities, harms our
health, and worsens the climate crisis — all to benefit Trump’s corporate
cronies. Now is the time to speak out.

We have until November 2 to voice opposition to this dangerous rollback.

Tell the EPA: Protect people from power plant pollution! https://links.messages.lcv. ADD YOUR NAME https://links.messages.lcv. Peter, Trump’s EPA is tearing down limits on carbon pollution from power plants — the
second-largest source of climate pollution in the country. Trump and EPA Administrator Zeldin are abandoning the EPA’s core mission to protect human health and the environment,and ignoring science. I recently testified against these rollbacks, and I
encourage you to speak out, too. Join me in speaking out against dangerous power plant pollution! https://links.messages.lcv. TAKE ACTION NOW https://links.messages.lcv. When I testified, I highlighted that this proposal is a giveaway to Trump and
Zeldin's fossil fuel cronies at the expense of the rest of us, our families'
health, budgets, and safety. This proposal also attempts to lock in a free pass
for coal and gas plants to pollute more now and into the future. This move will
benefit super wealthy oil and gas CEOs, while millions of Americans get sicker,
face more extreme weather, and pay more for energy. Not only do I lead federal policy here at LCV, but I’m also a former EPA health
scientist. And scientists overwhelmingly agree that carbon pollution from
burning coal, oil, and methane gas is fueling the climate crisis, with
devastating impacts on our health and communities across the country. The EPA must reverse course and start doing its job by protecting the
environment and putting the American people’s interests ahead of billionaire Big
Polluters. Add your name and urge the EPA to do its job >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/04wrM8- Thank you for joining LCV to stand up for the health of families and the
environment. Matthew Davis

[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
“Crossroads.” “A defining moment.” “Turning point.”

Whatever you call it, this election is going to test whether Pennsylvania
keeps choosing leaders who solve problems — or we let Donald Trump’s
allies drag our Commonwealth backward.

I know which side I’m on,
Derek.

I’m fighting for a Pennsylvania where kids can get a good education,
families can afford a good life, workers are treated with dignity, and
every person has the freedom to build their own future.

And that’s what we’ve been focused on from day one: Reopening I-95 in 12
days, delivering free school breakfast, cutting taxes ten times, investing
in safer communities, and getting stuff done.

But Derek, none of
that progress is guaranteed.

My far-right opponent has Donald Trump and his Mar-a-Lago donors in her
corner. They know Pennsylvania is the most important battleground state in
the country. And they know that if they flip this Governor’s office, the
far-right will control every state-level office in our Commonwealth.

That’s not a risk we can afford to take,
Derek.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/20438?t=1001&akid=793%2E245147%2E0A_499 ]So if you want this election to be a turning point for real freedom,
real results, and leadership that actually delivers, I’m asking you to
rush a donation today to help us win this race and keep Pennsylvania
moving forward.

Friend, it’s Pete Buttigieg.

Governors shape everyday life in ways people feel right away: the price of electricity, the quality of local schools, whether a family can find child care or afford a doctor’s visit. When Washington makes life harder for working families, a governor can be the first line of defense.

**That’s what’s at stake in New Hampshire this year, and it’s why I’m supporting Cinde Warmington for governor.**

On the Executive Council, she has worked to protect access to healthcare and affordable housing, strengthen public schools, safeguard reproductive rights, and expand access to child care. That’s the kind of record that makes for an effective governor.

clean_body: | | | Friend, it’s Pete Buttigieg. Governors shape everyday life in ways people feel right away: the price of electricity, the quality of local schools, whether a family can find child care or afford a doctor’s visit. When Washington makes life harder for working families, a governor can be the first line of defense. That’s what’s at stake in New Hampshire this year, and it’s why I’m supporting Cinde Warmington for governor. On the Executive Council, she has worked to protect access to healthcare and affordable housing, strengthen public schools, safeguard reproductive rights, and expand access to child care. That’s the kind of record that makes for an effective governor. Cinde is running for the right reasons: to make life more affordable for families who are working harder than ever and still falling behind, and to bring seriousness and decency to the work ahead. But with outside money pouring into this race, Cinde’s campaign needs the resources to reach Granite Staters in every corner of the state before Election Day. name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: Haven’t heard from us yet
body:
The future of Texas is being shaped by Latino voters.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
I’ve spent this last year traveling all across Texas, and everywhere I go, I meet Latino families who are tired. Tired of rising costs, tired of underfunded schools, and tired of being talked about but never talked to. They’re looking for someone who will actually fight for them.
Here’s the hard truth: too many of them haven’t heard enough from us. Not because they disagree with us, but because we haven’t had the resources to reach them yet.
And the stakes couldn’t be higher right now. Texas’ Latinos make up nearly a third of the state’s electorate, and more than 45% of young eligible voters in Texas. The future of this state is being shaped by Latino voters.
Yet, under Greg Abbott’s watch, Latino families have been abandoned. Latinos work harder than almost anyone in Texas, yet earn the lowest median wage of any major group. Nearly one in four has no health insurance, and nearly half of Latino renters are struggling to afford housing. Abbott has had years to fix this, and he’s chosen to look the other way.
Two-thirds of Latino eligible voters speak Spanish at home, and when pollsters survey Texans in both English and Spanish, we’re ahead nearly every time. That tells me everything I need to know: **when we reach Latino voters, we win.**
We need to reach voters on the airwaves and on the ground as much as possible right now. **[Will you rush a $5 donation to help us reach Latino voters?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261026_5_latinovote.UFuSaA&refcode=em20261026-2552&amount=5&t=1&akid=2552%2E299639%2EsK-wm9)**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261026_5_latinovote.UFuSaA&amount=5&refcode=em20261026-2552&t=20&akid=2552%2E299639%2EsK-wm9)
Thank you.
Gina

Hey, it's Barack Obama.

We have been through a lot over the past few years, and it's easy to feel cynical or overwhelmed. But I'm reaching out to you today to share a message of hope.

Hope isn't blind optimism. It arises in the face of uncertainty, discouragement, and even despair. Hope is why, even though we've been through dark times as a country before, getting through them has made us stronger and more resilient.

But we can't do it by standing still. We have to move forward. And right now, that means electing a Democratic Senate and restoring the checks and balances our founders carefully designed to protect us.

**[If you want to create real change, make a donation of $7 to the DSCC to help elect Senate Democrats who will fight for a better future for all of us, not just a few.](https://go.dscc.org/go/24212?amount=7&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=7&amounts=7%2C14%2C28%2C70&code=DPE-FD-20261026-BarackObama-ObamaHopeRF-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20261026-BarackObama-ObamaHopeRF-Pros-sl1&akid=27095%2E9716520%2EFL8He8)**

After everything that's happened over the last two years, after everything we've seen, America needs that message of hope right now. America needs _us_. **We can't just wait for things to get better on their own; we have to BE the change we seek.**

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: We cannot let this happen in New Hampshire
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
The GOP sees this race as one of their best opportunities to flip a Senate seat.
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20261026_3.qGfD3r&refcode=em20261026-3&t=1&akid=9784%2E582294%2ESkbfS8)
I know what it’s like to run against a Republican with high name ID and a national donor network behind him — I’ve done it before. And I won.
Now, Chris Pappas is facing the same kind of threat in New Hampshire. Donald Trump has personally endorsed former Senator John Sununu in this race — and the latest polling shows this race is a complete tie.
Look, in order for Democrats to take back the Senate majority and put an end to Trump’s unchecked power, winning in New Hampshire is absolutely critical.
**[That’s why I’m in this fight with everything I’ve got. And why I’m asking you to please pitch in $5 right now to help Chris Pappas stand up to big-money Republicans, compete against John Sununu, and keep this seat blue.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261026_3.m4bkzo&refcode=em20261026-3&t=2&akid=9784%2E582294%2ESkbfS8)**
**[Donate $5 to support Chris Pappas »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261026_3.m4bkzo&amount=5&refcode=em20261026-3&t=3&akid=9784%2E582294%2ESkbfS8)**
Chris is a Granite Stater through and through. He’s not in this for power or prestige or to cozy up to billionaires. _He’s in it to make life better for working families — the folks who get up every day, work hard, and are struggling to get by._ He’s fought Big Pharma to lower prescription drug prices, stood up for veterans, and protected reproductive rights when they’ve been under relentless attack.
Chris Pappas fights for the people — not the wealthy and well-connected. He shows up, he listens, and he gets things done. That’s what New Hampshire needs, and it’s what working people across the country need.
**But Republicans know New Hampshire is one of their best shots at flipping a Senate seat this year.** Sununu has the name recognition, the right-wing billionaire network, and the full weight of the national GOP behind him.
We’ve seen this before. Special interests will flood races with corporate money and try to buy Senators who will work for them instead of their constituents. We can’t let this happen in New Hampshire.
**If you believe, like I do, that government ought to work for working people — not the rich and powerful —[then I’m asking you to please chip in to Chris’s campaign now to help him compete and win.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261026_3.m4bkzo&refcode=em20261026-3&t=4&akid=9784%2E582294%2ESkbfS8)**
I know Chris has what it takes to win this race. But we all need to make sure he has the resources to fight back against this massive right-wing spending.
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_footer?refcode=em20261026-3&t=5&refcode2=9784_582294_SkbfS8&akid=9784%2E582294%2ESkbfS8)**

* [Update Your Information](https://act.chrispappas.org/signup/cps_update_your_information/?t=7&akid=9784%2E582294%2ESkbfS8)
* [Unsubscribe](https://act.chrispappas.org/unsubscribe/cps_unsubscribe/?t=8&akid=9784%2E582294%2ESkbfS8)

Email us: [teampappas@chrispappas.org](mailto:teampappas@chrispappas.org)

| | | | Peter, I have been fighting the National Firearms Act for **most of my adult life.** Last week, a federal court _finally_ told the government it cannot keep the registry. _Let me explain what happened, because the headline does not do it justice_ _..._ Since 1934, the NFA has forced Americans to register suppressors and short-barreled rifles, and the entire scheme rested on a $200 tax. When Congress eliminated that tax, it left the registration behind, and in doing so, **it knocked the constitutional legs out from under its****OWN****law!****** We took that argument into the Northern District of Texas in _Jensen v. ATF_ , and the judge AGREED with us. Now, here is the part I want you to understand clearly. SAF put the financial muscle behind that case. Our sister organization, the **Citizens Committee for the Right to Keep and Bear Arms** , carried it as a named plaintiff, and the court order in _Jensen_ reaches CCRKBA members across the country, current and future. Gottlieb. | | | | | Peter, I have been fighting the National Firearms Act for most of my adult life. Last week, a federal court finally told the government it cannot keep the registry. Let me explain what happened, because the headline does not do it justice ... Since 1934, the NFA has forced Americans to register suppressors and short-barreled rifles, and the entire scheme rested on a $200 tax. When Congress eliminated that tax, it left the registration behind, and in doing so, it knocked the constitutional legs out from under itsOWNlaw!** We took that argument into the Northern District of Texas in Jensen v. ATF , and the judge AGREED with us. Now, here is the part I want you to understand clearly. SAF put the financial muscle behind that case. Our sister organization, the Citizens Committee for the Right to Keep and Bear Arms , carried it as a named plaintiff, and the court order in Jensen reaches CCRKBA members across the country, current and future. So we are doing something we have NEVER DONE BEFORE! | Two organizations. Two sets of tools.Two membershi ps . ONE donation ! An opportunity like this may never happen again! body:
I need your eyes on this immediately

| This is Speaker Mike Johnson. I don’t often reach out like this, but it’s absolutely necessary. I need you to take every word of this seriously.
Election Day is less than 15 days away, and America’s future could be decided by one of the few REAL toss-up races in America.
My friend, Congressman Gabe Evans, is facing one of his toughest battles – and I don’t say that lightly. Roll Call, the Cook Political Report, and even National Democrats all agree his seat is a TOP target this year.
---
[](https://trk.emails.evansforcolorado._tJNTCfebQdajqe1I9LA)
---
In 2024, Gabe was the first Republican to flip a blue House seat in his state in over a DECADE. It was one of the CLOSEST races in America, and his victory was decided by less than 2,500 votes.**
**Gabe is the exact kind of patriot we need in Congress:**
**
* He served our country as an Army Black Hawk helicopter pilot in the Middle East.
* He protected his community as a police officer for over a decade.
* Today, he’s fighting for our conservative values in Congress.

**
**That's the kind of person we need fighting with us in Washington.**
**Gabe is a workhorse, not a show pony. He works day in and day out – one of his first actions after being sworn in was voting YES on the Laken Riley Act. Losing Gabe would be a disaster for our pro-Trump Majority.**
**That's exactly why Radical Democrats are spending MILLIONS against him to drown out his message.**
**They’ve made it their top goal to flip his seat and install another Socialist in his place.**
**His opponent, Manny Rutinel, is one of the MOST Radical Socialists in America.**
**
* He’s a Vegan who has called agriculture “horrific” and “exploitative”.

* He protested shirtless in the streets against eating meat.

* Was caught campaigning with Zohran Mamdani.

* He was arrested for running onto a football field during the game to protest oil and gas.

* He even sponsored legislation to force taxpayers to pay for transgender surgeries for minors.

**
**And that's only scratching the surface...**
**Socialists like Manny Rutinel are rising up across the country and are doing everything they can to force their radical agenda into every zip code in America.**
**We must do everything we can to protect our Conservative House Majority and STOP this socialist takeover dead in its tracks.
[ That’s why I’m personally asking you to stand with Gabe Evans today and help him win one of the MOST important House races in America.](https://trk.emails.evansforcolorado.)

Listen, the Midterms are less than 15 days away, and what happens in this race will decide the fate of our Conservative House Majority.
Without your help, we risk socialists seizing power, erasing our Majority, and demolishing the MAGA Agenda to ruins.
[For every minute we wait, Democrats are only getting closer to victory and silencing Gabe’s campaign. I’m counting on you to step up when I need you the most.](https://trk.emails.evansforcolorado._OzCR7_Grzpw0A)
---

---

To victory,
Speaker Mike Johnson

I’ve dedicated my entire life to service.
From flying Black Hawk helicopters in the Middle East to serving my community as a police officer.
I have and always will put serving my country and community first.
Now, I’m battling Democrats in my home state of Colorado to keep this battleground seat red! This race was one of the most expensive House races in 2024 – and I won by just a couple of thousand votes.

Case File No DRT-ED-STRAIT · Special File · The Date on the Calendar
Washington Has Spent Three Years Circling 2027. The Newest Assessment Just Moved the Date — and the Pressure on Taiwan Went Up Anyway.
Xi Jinping has long directed his military to be capable of taking Taiwan by force by 2027. In October, US officials told Reuters they now believe an invasion is unlikely before 2028. That is not the relief it sounds like. Around the island itself, the campaign that is already running — cyber, information, coast guard, drills — is intensifying ahead of Taiwan’s November 28 elections.
Threat level 4/5 — Elevated
| | | | | | | | |
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
|
---
A date is a strange thing to build an investment thesis on. But 2027 has shaped a decade of defense planning, supply chain policy and corporate risk committees, and the market has been pricing a binary — invasion or no invasion — for years. The more useful question is what happens in the long middle, where nothing is declared and everything is squeezed.
The evidence board
| | What the Record Shows
---|---
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit A — the date itself.** 2027 has always been described by analysts as a military readiness goal, not a scheduled invasion. The Office of the Director of National Intelligence’s March 2026 annual threat assessment said China had no plan at that point to invade in 2027. On October 1, 2026, Reuters reported that US officials increasingly believe Beijing is unlikely to move before 2028, citing disruption from Xi’s anti-corruption purge of the PLA’s senior ranks.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit B — what is happening now.** Taiwan’s National Security Bureau reported on October 22 that attacks on the Government Services Network rose to 185.6 million in July alone, averaging 2.58 million a day, and that it found 2.5 million suspect social media posts between January and August — 48% more than the same period in 2025. Taiwan votes in local elections on November 28.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit C — the hardware.** On October 14, 2026, four PLA Navy Type 071 landing platform docks — _Kunlunshan_ , _Changbaishan_ , _Qilianshan_ and _Wuzhishan_ — conducted live-fire training together, the first time four of them have trained as a group since August 2025.
| CHATTER
---
The de-escalation case is real. President Trump has played down the odds of an invasion and hosted Xi in Washington in late September. Several US officials believe Beijing will wait to see the result of Taiwan’s 2028 presidential election before deciding anything. China has never publicly confirmed any order to invade.
| OUR THEORY
---
Pushing the date out does not reduce the exposure; it extends the period during which it has to be managed. Companies do not wait for a date to re-site a fab or re-price a contract. The repricing of anything whose supply chain narrows to one island has already started, and it continues whether or not a single shot is fired.

---|---

What changed underneath is the producers. Twelve-month forward earnings expectations for the NYSE Arca Gold Miners Index reached $219.77 on September 30, 2026, against about $49.60 at the end of 2023. Dividends per share across the sector are at their highest levels in the twenty-year record, with many producers now holding net cash.
One analyst has spent the year arguing that the dividend story in gold is the part investors keep missing.

Dividends per share across the sector are at their highest levels in the twenty-year record, with many producers now holding net cash. One analyst has spent the year arguing that the dividend story in gold is the part investors keep missing. | | Sponsored by Golden Portfolio For instance: during the Great Depression, Homestake Mining not only paid out and grew its dividend from $7/share to $15/share, the stock also soared nearly 500%. Homestake was not only the world’s largest gold mine, and one of the richest. Today, a similar story is playing out in today’s richest gold mine. The company will pay out ~11% dividend yields in 2026 alone. It’s actively growing production and plans to pay out 100% of its free cash flow every quarter in dividends. And you can own this firm today. | Why it matters to you | | What a Long Middle Costs ---|--- | →| Concentration is the risk, not the headline. The question is not whether war comes; it is how much of your portfolio depends on one supply chain. ---|--- | →| Insurance gets priced before the event. Hedges are cheapest when nobody feels they need them. ---|--- | →| Relocation takes years, not weeks. Every fab moved is a decade-long capital decision made under a deadline nobody controls. ---|--- | ClassificationFile remains open The 2027 date has moved. The pressure campaign has not. Anything priced on the assumption that the strait stays quiet is making a bet, whether or not its owner knows it. Connected file | | Where the Money Went Instead ---|--- While the geopolitical story ran, American capital rotated somewhere unexpected. By mid-July 2026 the Russell 2000 was up 20% year to date, its strongest pace since 2003, against 11% for the S&P; 500 and 4% for the Magnificent 7. The internals were stranger still. HSBC data showed Russell 2000 companies with negative earnings up 45% year to date, against 18% for profitable ones — a reversal of the long-run pattern, and the kind of move that usually ends in a sharp sort. One analyst walks through the chart clues that show up before these moves, not after. | | Sponsored by StocksToTrade Tim Bohen's Money Monday video looks at the clues he watches for in small-cap setups, using historical charts. | | |

| | Monday, October 26

## THE RUSSO REPORT

From the Desk of Allison Russo
---
| |
---
| | [](https://zhwrg7hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0014-UJWcv7Sg9xZke7OaLb7_zlbP4gIthlT1s6hX40drTHXj6bAdi6_R31t0lv28ZGhgIB3KszSX6XEdSjpRvlS9NgGZ2CMoXOcttug-WvCbIttQ_8N6UaC0N5Puin_G8cG2uKSLBBXbDx_r1p73Ws7Q==&c=DsFAVnKAGBG2dfo8iK1GjxPsfz-GuXVAmD37mJ1Jcftu-jhlcHzuCw==&ch=NJ6tUsRkO-Hk2R6MR4sWeDqLC935M0zVncOtnLvdt9pRqlrlHYkVag==)
---
| A Note from Allison
Friends,
We have officially arrived at single digits--we are just 8 days away from Election Day!
Before we dive in, I want to take a quick moment to share that this is the second-to-last edition of The Russo Report before Election Day!
Sharing our updates, milestone moments, and campaign journey with you each week has been one of my favorite parts of this election, and I cannot thank you enough for staying engaged every step of the way.
---
| This past week was one of our most inspiring yet as momentum continues to build across Ohio. I was thrilled to spend several days on the trail with EMILY's List President Jessica Mackler. EMILY's List has been in my corner since my very first campaign in 2018, and having Jessica here to help us close out this race strong meant the world.
To cap it all off, joining President Obama and thousands of fired-up supporters in Cleveland on Saturday was an unforgettable reminder of what is at stake and the undeniable momentum driving us across the finish line.
With early voting in full swing across all 88 counties, every door knocked, phone call made, and conversation had over these next 8 days will decide this race.
Thank you for fueling this movement. Let's leave it all on the field!
With gratitude,
---
| |
---
| |
---
| Week in Review
---
| This week kicked off in Central Ohio with Emily's List President Jessica Mackler. Allison, Jessica, Rep. Beryl Brown Piccolantonio, and Councilwoman Tiara Ross were able to kick off a canvass launch in Clintonville together. After the canvass launch, Jessica and Allison were able to head up to Delaware County for an Amy Acton rally!
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| Wednesday was up to Northeast Ohio. Jessica and Allison held an event together in Cleveland Heights before Allison had to head over to Lake County for their annual Democratic Party Dinner.
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| Thursday kicked off in Cleveland as Allison was once again joined by Jessica Mackler, as well as Congresswoman Shontel Brown and her former colleague Shayla Davis for a press conference at the Cuyahoga County Board of Elections. With the theme of "The Power of The Vote," each speaker was able to highlight how powerful each individual person's vote actually is and the lengths to which people in power will go to weaken that power.
---
| |
---
| |
---
| Allison was able to end the day down in Gallia County for their first Democratic Party Dinner in 10 years! This renewed enthusiasm is happening all across Ohio in many of our rural counties, because folks are eager for real change in this state.
---
| |
---
| |
---
Friday was up to the Valley! Allison spent the day in Youngstown at a number of different events. First, a podcast recording with her friend and colleague, Representative Lauren McNally. Following the podcast, Allison visited the groundbreaking for new affordable housing in Youngstown supported by Ohio's Low-Income Housing Tax Credit and the Ohio Housing Finance Agency Board, where she is a member. Next up was a great discussion about voter engagement and outreach opportunities with Mahoning and Trumbull County faith leaders. And last, but certainly not least, she stopped by one of her favorite yearly events in the state: the Western Reserve Building and Construction Trades Council's Annual Fish Fry.
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| I think most people know what happened on Saturday, but what you don't know is that Allison actually started the day in Toledo. That's right, following her events in Youngstown, she made her way over to Toledo for the Northwest Ohio AFLCIO Brunch event. While she couldn't stay as long as she would have liked, there was no way she was missing this event! Getting a chance to be in a room full of labor leaders is always worth driving for.
---
| |
---
| |
---
| Now the moment you've all been waiting for....OBAMA! After leaving Toledo, Allison got right back over to Cleveland for an event that left everyone inspired. After a week that saw some of the lowest and most detestable politics we've seen in Ohio, it felt like medicine to listen to the former President fire up the crowd and remind everyone what is at stake.
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| To close out the week, it was back over to Youngstown for our weekly church service. This Sunday Allison was actually able to join two services! First, she joined Christ Centered Church with Bishop Kenneth Paramore and Senior Pastor Leta Paramore. Following Try-C service, Allison joined Third Baptist Church for their 152nd Anniversary Celebration. Third Baptist is now led by Allison's good friend, Pastor Vincent E. Peterson II. She was so honored to be able to join their anniversary and remembrance service.
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |

name: Molly Gray
subject: Six Stops, One Message: Vermont Is Ready for Change
body:
Dear Peter, This past weekend, I had the chance to connect with hundreds of Vermonters across the state, from Pownal and Bennington to Rutland, Brandon, and Vergennes. Everywhere we went, I heard a clear message: Vermonters are ready for change. They know the policies that got us here—with soaring housing and health care costs—won’t get us out of this affordability crisis. They’re tired of the divisiveness coming out of Washington and don’t want to see those same dirty politics take hold in Vermont. We packed a lot into the weekend, and I wanted to share a few highlights! **Saturday morning: From the Backroads at Wildstone Farm** We kicked off our third _From the Backroads_ stop at Wildstone Farm in Pownal. A huge thank-you to John Primmer for hosting us! John and Joy began farming in 1984 and were pioneers in the organic movement, becoming the first certified organic vegetable farm in Bennington County. We had a wonderful conversation about land use, access to markets, state agricultural policies, and the future of Vermont agriculture. This statewide tour is all about listening directly to farmers, landowners, and the people who keep our working lands thriving. As Lieutenant Governor, I’ll continue meeting Vermonters where they are and fighting to ensure every community has a voice in policymaking in Montpelier.
**Saturday afternoon: Town hall in Bennington** Next, we headed to Bennington for a town hall with Amanda Janoo. We had a packed house and a terrific conversation about the bright spots in Bennington County, the challenges facing the community, and what’s top of mind for local families.
**Saturday evening: The Rutland Halloween Parade** Then it was time to march with the Rutland County Democrats in the iconic Rutland Halloween Parade! We’re MOOOving Vermont forward on November 3rd. Thank you to everyone who cheered us on and brought the moo’s! With just eight days until Election Day, let’s bring that same energy to the polls.
**Sunday morning: Breakfast with Rutland veterans** We were up bright and early Sunday for breakfast with veterans at VFW Post 648 in Rutland. It was an honor to spend time with those who have served our country and hear their concerns. With costs continuing to rise, we need to make sure veterans and Vermonters living on fixed incomes can afford to live with dignity.
**Sunday afternoon: GOTV rallies in Brandon and Vergennes** We made two more stops to rally supporters and get out the vote! In downtown Brandon, we joined Tim Ash, Congresswoman Becca Balint, and others to build momentum for Election Day.
Then we wrapped up the weekend in Vergennes with another GOTV rally alongside Congresswoman Becca Balint, Ruth Hardy, Hannah Sessions, and so many more dedicated Vermonters.
**Eight days to go. Let’s finish strong.** Vermonters are ready for change, and this campaign is about more than winning on November 3rd. It’s about building the momentum and trust we need to do meaningful work in Montpelier next year: lowering costs, protecting Vermonters’ fundamental rights, and making life better for working families across our state. I’m so grateful to everyone who has opened their doors, joined us at an event, cheered us on, and helped spread the word. We’re in the final stretch, and every conversation, every volunteer, and every contribution makes a difference. **[If you’re able, please chip in to help cover a tank of gas as we travel the state in these final eight days. Every dollar helps us keep moving, reach more Vermonters, and get our message out before Election Day.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142238784/656254524/679520187?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZDQ5NTNjZS03OWQxLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eBmGhdosi3dC5AB93VrklkKA9Wlgo6dLSJ9541BCUcY=)**

Peter, it’s Pat. With Election Day right around the corner, I want us to think bigger about what comes next. We’re in a great position to take back the House, but if we’re going to rise to this moment, we have to be ambitious about what we fight for starting on November 4th. Even with Trump still in the White House, a strong Democratic majority can do a hell of a lot. We can hold public hearings, issue subpoenas, and make administration officials like Pete Hegseth answer for their actions. We can demand the records they’ve been hiding and give whistleblowers a chance to tell the American people what they know. We can lower the Medicare eligibility age to 50. We can pass the Lowering Utility Bills Act to stop utility companies from padding their profits at your expense. And we can restore the expanded Child Tax Credit to put more money in working parents’ pockets. I want a majority that fights aggressively to bring down the cost of gas and groceries, build affordable housing, stand up to tech oligarchs, and protect our freedoms. Americans deserve Democrats who are ready to use every tool at our disposal to make their lives better. **But to build that majority, we have to win big.** There’s a world of difference between winning the House back by two and by twenty seats. clean_body: What we can do with a Democratic majority | = Peter, it’s Pat. With Election Day right around the corner, I want us to think bigger about what comes next. We’re in a great position to take back the House, but if we’re going to rise to this moment, we have to be ambitious about what we fight for starting on November 4th. Even with Trump still in the White House, a strong Democratic majority can do a hell of a lot. We can hold public hearings, issue subpoenas, and make administration officials like Pete Hegseth answer for their actions. We can demand the records they’ve been hiding and give whistleblowers a chance to tell the American people what they know. = Democrats have to go beyond simply stopping the Trump administration from doing any more damage and fight for real, tangible reforms for working people on day one. We can lower the Medicare eligibility age to 50. We can pass the Lowering Utility Bills Act to stop utility companies from padding their profits at your expense. And we can restore the expanded Child Tax Credit to put more money in working parents’ pockets. I want a majority that fights aggressively to bring down the cost of gas and groceries, build affordable housing, stand up to tech oligarchs, and protect our freedoms. Americans deserve Democrats who are ready to use every tool at our disposal to make their lives better. But to build that majority, we have to win big. There’s a world of difference between winning the House back by two and by twenty seats. name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: This race just moved
body:
One week of early vote changed the math in this race.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter, I need you to see this.
When early voting opened, the experts had Greg Abbott ahead in this race.
_**Now one week of early vote is in, and projections built on who is actually turning out show this race closer than almost anyone expected.**_
That’s not a poll or a guess.**It’s real voters, casting real ballots, moving this race toward us.**
Here’s what it means: we are beating expectations. **This race is real, and it is winnable.** Greg Abbott and his allies have spent years telling Texans this state is out of reach. The early vote says otherwise.
But close still means coming up short. Closer isn’t the goal. We are running this race to WIN. **To get there, we have to turn out more voters than we did in week one: more of the Texans who sat out the last election, and more of the ones who still haven’t made up their minds.** We have one more week of early voting, then Election Day on November 3rd, to reach every one of them.

Peter,
Here’s a question I keep asking Republicans in Congress: _What’s your plan?_
What’s your plan to bring down rent? To lower grocery bills? To make sure no one goes bankrupt because they got sick?
**The truth is they don’t have a plan.**
Since Republicans let healthcare subsidies expire, insurance premiums that were already unaffordable have shot up even more. Rent is crushing people. Childcare costs as much as a mortgage. And MAGA’s answer is...nothing.
Instead, their goal is to divide us. That’s why they’re attacking trans kids, scapegoating immigrants, and demonizing Muslims like Abdul El-Sayed as “terrorists.” Anything to keep you from noticing that they’ve delivered _nothing_ for working people while delivering _everything_ for the ultra-rich.
**But here’s the thing Republicans don’t want you to realize, Peter: We don’t have to choose.**
We can bring down costs _and_ defend LGBTQ+ rights.
We can pass Medicare For All _and_ make sure our government treats every person with dignity, no matter where they come from, how they pray, or who they love.
So as Republicans’ attacks on vulnerable people ramp up in this final week before the election, just remember that the only reason they’re doing this is because they’re desperate. They know they’ve got nothing, and they know working people are lining up to vote against them.
Now it’s our job to turn out in huge numbers across the country so that we can flip the House, take back the Senate, and start holding this corrupt, authoritarian administration accountable.

name: Derrick Van Orden
subject: I was reflecting on Isaiah 59:19
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Van Orden for Congress
body:
| | When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD will lift up a standard against him.
~ Isaiah 59:19
---
Peter - I'm sure I don't really need to tell you this, but we're in a spiritual battle. This isn't a game or some kind of hyperbole; the soul of our nation is on the line right now.
The other day, I read and reflected on Isaiah 59:19. The passage reads: When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD will lift up a standard against him.
Unfortunately, sick and godless ideology is festering in our nation today. Liberal billionaires and coastal elites have bankrolled monsters in their scheme to take the House Majority and thrust America into chaos.
My Team and I are fighting to defend the House majority from these lunatics. If we fail in Congress, our nation will quickly fall to this insidious evil too.
Listen, I'm not going to tell you this will be easy. Protecting our Christian way of life, our children, and our shared values is a tall order. But this short excerpt from Isaiah reminded me that with the Lord on our side, we shall overcome all that stands against us!
No matter what my role was, from Navy SEAL to husband and father, I have always led with the light of Christ and that's not about to change when we defend the House in November. But I can't win this race without your prayers and support.

### About Chaz Molder
