Hey folks,
Barack Obama is back on the campaign trail and Donald Trump absolutely cannot handle it.
With nine days until the midterms, Obama is packing rallies in Ohio and Michigan, hammering Trump on the economy, the war, corruption, and yes, his bizarre obsession with renovating the White House. Trump's response? Complaining about Obama and arguing about crowd sizes. Again.
* [**00:01:28**] Trump responds to Obama roasting his White House renovations, and the best comeback he can muster is calling Obama a "lousy president."
* [**00:03:07**] Trump falls right back into his decades-old obsession with Obama, attacks his crowds, and revives the same ugly rhetoric Republicans have recycled for years.
* [**00:06:18**] Obama draws huge crowds and an overflow room in Michigan while Trump insists nobody wants to see him, and the contrast is getting impossible to ignore.
* [**00:09:15**] We get into the issue that could decide these midterms: affordability. New polling shows Americans deeply pessimistic about the economy, creating serious problems for Republicans.
* [**00:11:18**] Democrats deploy Obama across the country as competitive races emerge in places nobody expected, and Republicans increasingly have to decide whether they even want Trump beside them.

This isn't about nostalgia for Barack Obama. It's about the contrast voters are seeing right now. Obama is talking about people's lives, affordability, corruption, and the stakes of this election while Trump keeps retreating into grievances and fantasies about crowd sizes. We have nine days to turn that contrast into votes. **If you value independent media keeping the focus on what actually matters, help me keep building it.**

body:
The New York Times fielded opinions on the Supreme Court this month. We want to know what YOU think. | |
---
Peter, This month, a New York Times Opinion writer scorched the captured Supreme Court and proposed several reforms to rein in its power, including term limits, ethics rules, limiting the shadow docket, and expanding the Court.1 **Her thesis was simple: the Supreme Court needs to change. But we want to hear from the people who make up our democracy. What do you think?**
### Does the Supreme Court need to change?
[VOTE YES](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquycZLnmoOTtIzST1HuOs_b2Le95fYf8FJa0gFKSejD4ravLGfvcemwnuTQ0UOGiy4YczWoXwoDYVJlx4I88PD2Jxw9lc9v7tLXcZukLs4OXW5j8JP_0j9BfQj0QMQfUpNbM_8OfdMVyb0k1_nUDBzuT1iWtkAZm9MBbAmLhSksr6yJ08wCXx20T3EvwdPdVB1ZeZOGZt3EeDNEogVkkaMyZuo1153l8QAnV0jjPXLbbf9Y0cA30PLumHg5aKT0-uzoHQpiYBcYk5J5ZHyHseDHVUpYG0zQWajUVsrU1GclXdlNYLnmpn_cyugZznImsB7a116v0bAyzF6_OXtK-CmT/4v7/HD5HA9SWTJeiW5Jhq_ihHw/h0/h001.q20--fCXIMjxl0PhBoj9NkTs79h78PGNFTzCJh_e3Xk) [VOTE NO](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquycZLnmoOTtIzST1HuOs_bSmmtUlWcX4g25B-GBXc6QC5amFjU7FraXPWPYeqxZGrPdcG-CgGS9DqxN1SPjT4gCFlwzRmK-Ii4sA5W_klr3ER65OVqxd-71GAwBbEAqwWRj0UcJUnkVARuz_wcfQTAPkgQXmVlZ14llkM-1AhmjnPMxyGVvwOdkoWEQszfGAf5HRDJyVdDaWpsFgeSDh7u8GU1uGB30JLFBaIIY9D_R6HxCcG5lpEStIEePL37JG7N5wIOT09GvUuT5bBBNRpo8kFrLPk_TdCsYag1eLTHT1zdmLLIiX07Kyr-wquPIe619IDxi0yXUK9ns_5sPzfN/4v7/HD5HA9SWTJeiW5Jhq_ihHw/h1/h001.kSMPT9hym1jt3i_TJ-J-7GVItYf-u4lXUdB1oiZ96IU) The opinion piece received several replies from people across the country.2 A retired lawyer in Connecticut said that “life tenure has successfully maintained the judicial independence of the court,” with long service “soundness of the court’s performance through the years.” Hmm... **A New Orleans resident advocated for a shadow court, or a constitutional court, to “create advisory opinions and opinions that would compete with those of the Supreme Court.”** Steven from New Jersey thinks that “the court is functioning much as our constitutional system anticipated.” A teacher from Boston concludes that “even with such necessary reforms, the Supreme Court and the rule of law are sadly flawed.” **Naomi from New York places the blame squarely on the Federalist Society, the shadowy group of wealthy elites who packed the Court. She says, “[The Federalist Society] has given us judges, especially on the Supreme Court, who are now shredding our Constitution and burning the remains to death.”** There are so many ways our judicial system is failing us, and so many ways to improve it. But one thing is clear in the polling: the Supreme Court has never had such a low vote of confidence from the American people. **Sound off now! 📣**

**Peter, if this is the last email you see from my campaign, I’m okay with that. ** Laken Riley was murdered; that’s a fact. Her family begged for help, and I couldn’t sit on the sidelines; I wrote the law myself so the family of a murdered woman could get justice. Jon Ossoff voted ‘NO,’ and I looked him in the eye. He stared right through me. He was complicit in abandoning his duty to the people he’s supposed to represent.
He was complicit in letting justice slip through the Riley family's fingers. That’s who Jon Ossoff is. That’s his legacy. Unfortunately, Jon Ossoff’s friends in the Democrat party are more than happy to funnel money and support to a man who is willing to betray his constituents if it means currying favor with his overlords in the establishment. **That’s what we’re up against on Election Day.** Georgia has a choice: give a man who will stand by as the people he represents are murdered six more years in office, or change things for the better and elect someone who will actually fight for his neighbors. Jon Ossoff’s friends are funneling money into this race because they want the people of Georgia to forget that he said ‘NO’ when we demanded justice for Laken Riley’s life. _**I won’t let that happen. **_ I’m fighting like my life depends on it, because there were people whose lives were taken from them because Democrats like Jon Ossoff refuse to do what they promised and look out for the people who voted for them. I won’t make this some long-winded fundraising email, because I’m as mad as a wet hen. I'm so proud to call myself a Kansan and to have met so many fellow Kansans on the campaign trail this year. While we may not always agree on everything politically - we're a healthy mix of Republicans, Democrats and independents - there are **folks from** _**all 105 counties**_**who can agree on one thing: It 's time Kansas had a Senator who will **_**listen**_**.**
That's why Kansans from every county have chipped in to power this campaign. **Thanks to this grassroots team, our momentum is surging, but I need your help to cross the finish line in eight days.[Will you join folks in every Kansas county by chipping in today?](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f2f9c2ca-b7ff-4bd6-afac-74b423f2f9d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Here's why this is such a big milestone for our campaign: From the very beginning, I made a commitment to refuse even a single dime of corporate PAC money. It wasn't the easy route. But I'm running to serve Kansans in Washington, not special interests.
Every milestone we've reached, every ad we've aired and every point we've gained in the polls has been because folks like _you_ believed that this campaign is a worthy cause for your support.
It took us five months and tens of thousands of grassroots donations to raise $15 million for this campaign. Those resources have been invaluable -- it's helped us turn this safe seat into a real battleground. **But Sen. Marshall got that same amount in a single day from one of the biggest super PACs in the country.**
That's what we're up against. Sen. Marshall's Washington insider allies have a virtually unlimited war chest that they can unleash whenever -- and in these eight days before Election Day, we can expect them to drop millions more in attack ads.
**That 's why I'm personally asking you to chip in today. If we don't respond to super PAC spending with a surge of grassroots support, we risk letting Marshall's allies drown us out in these decisive final days.**
**[Please, join folks from all 105 Kansas counties supporting this campaign by making a contribution today.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f2f9c2ca-b7ff-4bd6-afac-74b423f2f9d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) I'm counting on this grassroots team to prove that Kansas isn't for sale. Please, pitch in before midnight.**
[Donate](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f2f9c2ca-b7ff-4bd6-afac-74b423f2f9d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thanks,
Adam Hamilton

Friend, With Election Day eight days away, I want to take a minute to reflect on how we got here and what we’re fighting for. When I first joined the Glendale City Council, it was dominated by conservative voices. Many thought Glendale couldn’t move forward. But instead of backing down, we organized, successfully fought for progressive values, and banned the Glendale Gun Show from public property. And in the State Assembly, I fought for bold initiatives to tackle climate change, protect reproductive rights, and push for real health care reforms—despite strong opposition from corporate interests and special interest groups. **Throughout my years of public service, I’ve learned that creating lasting, meaningful change is tough. But that doesn't mean we should ever compromise our values or give up on our vision.** Just in these first two years, we’ve built consensus to keep film jobs home, made our streets safer, fought for accountability for rogue ICE agents, and supported disaster recovery and housing affordability legislation for Angelenos. **And I know there’s so much more to come.** We’re here to build a world where our air and water are clean, where our communities are free from the scourge of gun violence, and where reproductive freedom is restored for all. But it will take each and every one of us to make that world a reality. [**We’re coming up on our final end-of-month fundraising deadline of the election, and I’d greatly appreciate your support. clean_body: | = Friend, With Election Day eight days away, I want to take a minute to reflect on how we got here and what we’re fighting for. When I first joined the Glendale City Council, it was dominated by conservative voices. Many thought Glendale couldn’t move forward. But instead of backing down, we organized, successfully fought for progressive values, and banned the Glendale Gun Show from public property. And in the State Assembly, I fought for bold initiatives to tackle climate change, protect reproductive rights, and push for real health care reforms—despite strong opposition from corporate interests and special interest groups. Throughout my years of public service, I’ve learned that creating lasting, meaningful change is tough. But that doesn't mean we should ever compromise our values or give up on our vision. Just in these first two years, we’ve built consensus to keep film jobs home, made our streets safer, fought for accountability for rogue ICE agents, and supported disaster recovery and housing affordability legislation for Angelenos. And I know there’s so much more to come. We’re here to build a world where our air and water are clean, where our communities are free from the scourge of gun violence, and where reproductive freedom is restored for all. Gateway Community Services CEO Abdullahi Ali appears alongside Maine Gov. Janet Mills and Ekhlas Ahmed, a former Gateway Community Services employee who now works for the Office of New Americans.
Gateway Community Services started out billing MaineCare for translation and grew into a Medicaid agency doing about $5 million a year. It was audited three times, found to have overbilled Medicaid every time, and never paid it back. Along the way, Gateway and its founder, Somali-American refugee Abdullahi Ali, became a cornerstone of the Maine Democratic Party's "Get Out the Vote" strategy in Portland, Lewiston, and other urban areas with large non-English-speaking populations. Beginning in 2022, Gateway accepted no-bid contracts from the Mills Administration for "community health outreach" while simultaneously creating and running the Community Organizing Alliance, an explicitly political group aimed at turning out non-English-speaking migrants to vote for Maine Democrats. The entire scheme came crashing down when the Maine Wire began reporting on failed audits, allegations of fraud, and Ali's botched presidential campaign in Jubbaland.
The Robinson Report does deep investigations into the forces manipulating government and politics in Maine. Support our work today!
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..MDkW-6MGVXouu1nqMqnedGMIvcvhOmWXV4NF1aq_iXs?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=222217767)
We cover the whole saga: Ali's Jubaland presidential campaign, Deqa Dhalac working there while she sat in the legislature, whistleblower Chris Bernardini and the alleged timesheet fraud, $400,000 in opioid settlement money, and the no-bid CHOW contracts that kept migrant outreach workers going door to door and on the payroll through the 2024 election, and the Community Organizing Alliance. Nobody has been arrested or charged; Gateway was defunded, Ali is on the lam, and the bank took his house. Yet the Community Organizing Alliance can still be found today hustling voters from vans into Lewiston City Hall.

**We won 't be that team.**

But we're FAR from throwing in the towel.
Now that we're in the home stretch, your direct support to me and this movement becomes even more important.

Today is Monday, October 26. Ten days from now, the National Capital Planning Commission, stacked with Trump officials, will be taking a final vote to approve the 250-foot Arc de Trump, just beyond the gates of Arlington National Cemetery.
Trump’s arch would be a permanent stain on our country.

I just got back from Texas, and I’m still fired up. Yesterday, I joined a huge crowd of volunteers and neighbors to get out the vote for Gina Hinojosa, Dexter McCoy, Congresswoman Lizzie Fletcher, and Jon Rosenthal, amongst others. The energy was unreal. **[Before I tell you why this race matters so much, chip in $10 or $40 to Equal Opportunity Now and help us keep showing up like this. ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142242862/656268019/1090555623?amount=10&refcode=261026_texasevent&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZGM3NTVhZC04NGQxLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aMfzpnCMP1YDDh3Rgj2vtryTtJ_ihWJKa5EtI6CQy8Y=)** Here’s why we were there, and why I was so proud to be supporting Jon Rosenthal in particular: A few weeks ago, Bo French posted a photo of University of Texas students celebrating their team’s win and wrote that “the problem is now obviously far worse than anyone imagined.” Those students are Americans, and many were born in Texas. French called them “foreigners” and said Americans were being “displaced.” When folks told French to take down the post, he refused. Then he used the backlash to raise money. **I know what it’s like to be told you don’t belong. A sitting elected official once called me a “foreign occupier.” I’ve seen where this kind of hate can lead, and I will never stay quiet about it. Not in Illinois. Not in Texas. Not anywhere.** That’s what Equal Opportunity Now is about. We stand up to bigotry no matter where it shows up. We show up on the ground, we knock the doors, and we make our voices heard. This race is a dead heat, and Republicans haven’t lost a statewide race in Texas in more than three decades. With a little over a week left, every volunteer, every door, and every dollar counts. **[A crowd like that doesn’t happen by accident. It happens because people decide to show up. Peter - I'm sure I don't really need to tell you this, but we're in a spiritual battle. This isn't a game or some kind of hyperbole; the soul of our nation is on the line right now.
The other day, I read and reflected on Isaiah 59:19. The passage reads: When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD will lift up a standard against him.
Unfortunately, sick and godless ideology is festering in our nation today. Liberal billionaires and coastal elites have bankrolled monsters in their scheme to take the House Majority and thrust America into chaos.
My Team and I are fighting to defend the House majority from these lunatics. If we fail in Congress, our nation will quickly fall to this insidious evil too.
Listen, I'm not going to tell you this will be easy. Protecting our Christian way of life, our children, and our shared values is a tall order. But this short excerpt from Isaiah reminded me that with the Lord on our side, we shall overcome all that stands against us!

body:
| | | |
---
**Boysko Bulletin:****Town Hall 10/27 - Understanding Your Energy Bill**
---
Dear Peter, Many constituents have written to me regarding increases in their utility bills. I’ve also seen a significant jump on my bill. My office refers constituents to our utility companies for an explanation of their bills and to resolve any possible errors. I attended a utility regulation seminar a few weeks ago and found it helpful to understand why we have seen such increases. Tomorrow, October 27 at 6:30 pm, Delegate Sullivan and I are holding a town hall with an expert on utility regulation who will explain our utility bills and why we are seeing significant jumps. Please join us. You can [rsvp in advance](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142243300/656269559/-904906303?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDI2MjQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTBjMzRhNWQtODZkMS1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjlmODY5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=qLswtJDmJd3qS2rddKFvnXIeRKE_tno5pwsHy77CvNE=&emci=845b681b-81d1-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&emdi=a0c34a5d-86d1-f111-bf5b-00224829f869&ceid=22486556) if you wish. **Public Comment Opportunities Next Era - Dominion Proposed Merger ** The Virginia State Corporation Commission (SCC) has the authority to approve or block the proposed merger if it determines the deal does not benefit or if it harms Virginia ratepayers. The SCC is in the process of conducting a robust examination of the proposal and the staff recommended against the merger as it was proposed. clean_body: They're doing everything they can to turn this state blue. | Fellow Patriot, I sat down with Sean Hannity to talk about this race, and I said what a lot of South Carolinians are already thinking: The Democrats are pouring money into this state to flip it blue. My opponent, Annie Andrews, is spending millions on TV ads calling me a liar. And Hollywood is lining up behind her, because they know what's at stake. Flipping a Senate seat in South Carolina would be their biggest win of the cycle. I'm not going to let that happen. I won't let Hollywood elites and out-of-state liberals buy a Senate seat that belongs to the people of South Carolina. But I can't match $1 million a week on my own. Grassroots conservatives are the only thing standing between this state and the most radical Democrat ever nominated statewide in South Carolina. Every dollar goes straight into getting the truth on the air before their lies settle in. If enough of us chip in today, we can answer every ad they run. Thank you for standing with me. It’s Mary
Peltola. I want you to hear this from me:

The Trump Administration is suing preemptively to try to keep Dan Sullivan
in power because they're terrified he’ll lose this race in eight days.

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20261026-split-mp.XUejom&refcode=em20261026-61941&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=61941%2E1407376%2E7cX6zq ]Headline from AP NEWS: 'Trump administration sues to block possible
Democratic win in Alaska Senate race.'

Look, I’m not used to this Lower 48
hyperpartisan BS.

It’s not how we do things in Alaska. Where I’m from in the Bush, there’s a
big premium on respect. We depend on each other too much to burn bridges
over political differences.

But if they think I won’t fight back when DC people try to play partisan
games with our future, they’ve got another thing coming.

I’m running to take on the rigged DC system that’s hurting all of us, and
I won’t let this sham stop me.

But the truth is, the only way we’re going to make sure every single
Alaskan’s voice is heard over the next eight days is together. That's why
I need all hands on deck right now to respond.

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20261026-split-mp.XUejom&refcode=em20261026-61941&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=61941%2E1407376%2E7cX6zq ]If you’re with me, please split a $5 contribution

stepping up, we can overcome any obstacle and take this fight for fish,

I’m the underdog in this battle against the DC establishment, so I’m
counting on a huge grassroots effort to fight back in this final stretch.

We need to send a strong message to everyone watching that we won’t let
their meddling stop us. So thank you for coming together to help me do
just that.

Together,

Mary

Long before data centers were front-page news, I was pushing to fix how we build and pay for our power grid.

That fight is now the _Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act_. It’s the product of years of negotiations, it includes pieces of legislation I introduced, and I’m pushing to get it done in this Congress.
**Here’s what it does:**
* If you build a data center, _you pay for every kilowatt of electricity you use_.
* _You pay for all of the infrastructure it takes to hook you up to the grid_.
* _Those rules cover every data center in America_ - including the one being floated for NAVWAR.

**Not San Diego families. Not small businesses.**
**We are close to getting this passed, but Big Tech has plenty of lobbyists in Washington.** **Congress needs to know that tens of thousands of supporters are standing together to demand accountability from data centers. A developer is floating a 400-megawatt data center on the Navy’s NAVWAR campus in Old Town. I said NO from day one. Today I’m saying it again: this is the wrong project in the wrong place, and I oppose it. But saying no isn’t enough. We need rules with teeth, and I have the bill to deliver them. If you’re with me, add your name to the petition: | | Long before data centers were front-page news, I was pushing to fix how we build and pay for our power grid. That fight is now the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act. It’s the product of years of negotiations, it includes pieces of legislation I introduced, and I’m pushing to get it done in this Congress. Here’s what it does: If you build a data center, you pay for every kilowatt of electricity you use. You pay for all of the infrastructure it takes to hook you up to the grid. Those rules cover every data center in America - including the one being floated for NAVWAR. Not San Diego families. Not small businesses. We are close to getting this passed, but Big Tech has plenty of lobbyists in Washington. | | Friend, The Minnesota Police and Peace Officers Association previously endorsed my campaign. That’s more than 10,000 rank-and-file officers, and I don’t take their trust lightly. Now the Fraternal Order of Police, which represents thousands more of our brave men and women in law enforcement, has endorsed me. When the defund movement took hold in Minneapolis, I stood up to it and made sure everyone knew I backed the blue. Families here want to know a deputy will show up when they call 911. We know our cops are the people who protect us from criminals and gang violence that permeates Democrat run cities like Minneapolis. I’ve fought to get more resources to small-town departments, and this summer I sat down multiple times with sheriffs, police chiefs, and other officers and deputies from across southern Minnesota to hear what they need from Washington. Police are endorsing me because they know I have their back. And they know my opponent Jake Johnson has called law enforcement officers a ‘poorly-trained, well-funded militia’. The choice is clear and consequences of coming up short could be catastrophic.Walz and National Democrats see an opening here, and they’re spending big to take this seat. Last week, the Cook Political Report moved our race one step closer to a toss-up.**Will you stand with the men and women who keep us safe, and with me, before Election Day?**

clean_body: The Minnesota Police and Peace Officers Association and the Fraternal Order of Police are backing this campaign.| | | | | | Friend, The Minnesota Police and Peace Officers Association previously endorsed my campaign. That’s more than 10,000 rank-and-file officers, and I don’t take their trust lightly. Now the Fraternal Order of Police, which represents thousands more of our brave men and women in law enforcement, has endorsed me. When the defund movement took hold in Minneapolis, I stood up to it and made sure everyone knew I backed the blue. Families here want to know a deputy will show up when they call 911. We know our cops are the people who protect us from criminals and gang violence that permeates Democrat run cities like Minneapolis. I’ve fought to get more resources to small-town departments, and this summer I sat down multiple times with sheriffs, police chiefs, and other officers and deputies from across southern Minnesota to hear what they need from Washington. Police are endorsing me because they know I have their back. And they know my opponent Jake Johnson has called law enforcement officers a ‘poorly-trained, well-funded militia’. The choice is clear and consequences of coming up short could be catastrophic.Walz and National Democrats see an opening here, and they’re spending big to take this seat. Last week, the Cook Political Report moved our race one step closer to a toss-up.Will you stand with the men and women who keep us safe, and with me, before Election Day? — Brad | P.S. Early voting is already underway across southern Minnesota. Every gift today helps us reach voters before they cast their ballots. | | Paid for by Finstad for Congress

Peter,
I was a freshman at West Point when the Twin Towers fell.
None of us who were there will ever forget that morning. We'd signed up to serve a country at peace. By that afternoon, every cadet in my class knew we'd be going to war.
Not one of us flinched.
Over nine combat tours in Afghanistan and Iraq, I flew the Apache attack helicopter and then MH-47G Chinooks with the 160th SOAR "Night Stalkers," carrying special operators into places most Americans will never see. I did it because I love this country more than I love my own life. Every man on those birds felt the same way.
**And I’m still committed to fighting for this country today – but what I see happening here at home terrifies me.**
_Here 's why._
America has never been beaten from the outside. After Pearl Harbor, we rallied and won a world war. After 9/11, we took the fight to the terrorists who attacked us. Give our warfighters what they need and put them on any battlefield against any enemy on earth – and we win.
Abraham Lincoln understood this almost 200 years ago. He said the danger to America would never come from abroad. "If destruction be our lot," he warned, "we must ourselves be its author and finisher."
**That 's exactly what the radical Left is doing. Brick by brick, they're tearing America down from the inside.**
**_Our sovereignty?_** They threw open our southern border and allowed cartels to smuggle in dangerous drugs and criminals. They voted against requiring proof of citizenship to vote. A nation that can't control who comes in or who casts its ballots isn't a nation for long.
**_Our culture?_** They sneer at the flag, the troops, and the Constitution those troops swore to defend. Faith, family and hard work – the things that built this country – they treat as something to be ashamed of.
**_And our kids?_** That's what keeps me up at night. The Left wants our children taught that America is rotten to the core. That the greatest gift they'll ever receive – being born American – is something to apologize for.
A generation that's taught to hate its country won't defend it. And the socialists know it.
Today's Democratic Party isn't the party your parents knew. Socialists from the DSA wing are running the show now. And the so-called moderate, pro-America Democrats? They've had every chance to stand up to this monster. They've proven they either won't or can't.
_So it 's up to us._
**And in just a matter of days, the socialists have a real shot at taking back the House.**
Our majority is razor-thin. Democrats don't need a wave – they need to flip just a handful of seats. **Every single race in the country is on the table, and they 're pouring money into all of them at once.**
If they pull it off, Hakeem Jeffries gets the gavel. And the socialists get the keys.

**This is the whole ballgame. Not one race._The entire House._**
I know that fight better than most. Last December, when our majority was on the line in Tennessee's special election, national Democrats threw everything they had at it. We beat them by nearly 9 points. Now they want revenge – on me and on every Republican standing between them and power.
**In just a matter of days, it all comes down to Election Day.** The Democrats and their media allies are watching every close race for a Republican who looks weak. Wherever they see weakness, they'll pile on. Wherever they see strength, they'll think twice.

clean_body: | Peter, I was a freshman at West Point when the Twin Towers fell. None of us who were there will ever forget that morning. We'd signed up to serve a country at peace. By that afternoon, every cadet in my class knew we'd be going to war. Not one of us flinched. Over nine combat tours in Afghanistan and Iraq, I flew the Apache attack helicopter and then MH-47G Chinooks with the 160th SOAR "Night Stalkers," carrying special operators into places most Americans will never see. I did it because I love this country more than I love my own life. Every man on those birds felt the same way. And I’m still committed to fighting for this country today – but what I see happening here at home terrifies me. Here 's why. America has never been beaten from the outside. After Pearl Harbor, we rallied and won a world war. After 9/11, we took the fight to the terrorists who attacked us. Give our warfighters what they need and put them on any battlefield against any enemy on earth – and we win. Abraham Lincoln understood this almost 200 years ago. He said the danger to America would never come from abroad. "If destruction be our lot," he warned, "we must ourselves be its author and finisher." That 's exactly what the radical Left is doing. Brick by brick, they're tearing America down from the inside. Our sovereignty? They threw open our southern border and allowed cartels to smuggle in dangerous drugs and criminals. They voted against requiring proof of citizenship to vote. A nation that can't control who comes in or who casts its ballots isn't a nation for long. Our culture? They sneer at the flag, the troops, and the Constitution those troops swore to defend. Faith, family and hard work – the things that built this country – they treat as something to be ashamed of. And our kids? That's what keeps me up at night. The Left wants our children taught that America is rotten to the core. That the greatest gift they'll ever receive – being born American – is something to apologize for. A generation that's taught to hate its country won't defend it. And the socialists know it. Today's Democratic Party isn't the party your parents knew. Socialists from the DSA wing are running the show now. And the so-called moderate, pro-America Democrats? They've had every chance to stand up to this monster. They've proven they either won't or can't. So it 's up to us. And in just a matter of days, the socialists have a real shot at taking back the House. Our majority is razor-thin. Democrats don't need a wave – they need to flip just a handful of seats. Every single race in the country is on the table, and they 're pouring money into all of them at once. If they pull it off, Hakeem Jeffries gets the gavel. And the socialists get the keys. | You know what comes next. Endless witch hunts. Impeachment circuses. Every bill to secure the border and protect our elections will be dead on arrival. Two more years of the Left fighting to undo everything we've accomplished – and setting the stage to finish the job in 2028. This is the whole ballgame. Not one race.The entire House. I know that fight better than most. Last December, when our majority was on the line in Tennessee's special election, national Democrats threw everything they had at it. We beat them by nearly 9 points. Now they want revenge – on me and on every Republican standing between them and power. In just a matter of days, it all comes down to Election Day. The Democrats and their media allies are watching every close race for a Republican who looks weak. Wherever they see weakness, they'll pile on. Wherever they see strength, they'll think twice. That 's why I'm coming to you directly. I 'm asking you to stand in the gap over these next few days – because right now, the House is the line, and we need patriots holding it. The country's on the line and the threat is coming from within. That’s why I'm asking you to answer the call with me – for our sovereignty, for our way of life and for the kids who deserve to inherit the same America we did. Please don 't wait. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqiBIysd_1t7dQL51NYrcynj_UHKTnEbFJuXRbcU0RusMeK8Uw0hMFlhZHdKfCOjyn-8fbiUvjghI0_OO5PRlpdWHXlvpHA5a-W4I7PPPKi31hP3YOJXOnOINoLnG4fSDqo0_HehBJmEf5RijaKKRUOMRNlIacZDVe05qBPgchd1OVLOGZxNr9jVK39paydNVQkan9cJPpQbp-qx_6AHofxzcTNPXNjYDVj0Ue0kZdm3CWfNfHpp9M5bkolxY6rNzjkIAJs1AiGz3TEo7MFmsuePPCGFrjWDEAOKbyUYN9Yw/4v7/ju7JjMZuQjyb-PI4HPqtSQ/h2/h001.hCSfWwNs1shloBBcBgLiR2c4QOBQ4rvfOPr-A2poy40) My mom was a postal worker for 48 years in the Hudson Valley, and my dad was a construction worker. Together they taught me the values of hard work and service. That service became very real after 9/11. I was a junior in High School when the Twin Towers fell — and the next day I started my West Point application. Then Congressman Maurice Hinchey provided my congressional nomination for West Point. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqiBIysd_1t7dQL51NYrcynj_UHKTnEbFJuXRbcU0RusMeK8Uw0hMFlhZHdKfCOjyn-8fbiUvjghI0_OO5PRlpeBdvWo3--Vb2CjwlxY9WiI5ngDz0jjzJCpk1yGl60AUO--VY5kBx42P0NtEEUBNlyXSDXhbGHzIC2VNRaZDADWNvRzuB5UswOYcGh6nPfNAD5tbKIANkUxeOHOBRPTNPUXOXzN9i92zfE2rjT1d5MQZf_Hc3xHirYxJtLplqmY4RDzYryX01gMlOgfqmKheJmO-Byik2m7X9VkldM5EzRg/4v7/ju7JjMZuQjyb-PI4HPqtSQ/h3/h001.NKwdRoeDeQ-4ihDPaqN5Ob9Xp3VZC7SCSbuEqU01iuk) I was the first in my family to graduate from college. After that, I went on to earn master’s degrees from MIT and Harvard. I served for 16 years as an active duty Army officer, deploying overseas six times to keep America safe and hunt down the world’s most dangerous terrorists. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqiBIysd_1t7dQL51NYrcynj_UHKTnEbFJuXRbcU0RusMeK8Uw0hMFlhZHdKfCOjyn-8fbiUvjghI0_OO5PRlpreORNEd18u2EzjHwPRebKh1OfqEaBMDGR2GXedXcMQFCwla8HXryHmLTGTgYoLHK3d1CT9HhXbZuWffjswe1OjJbNp6tlK7uXgoU1U5iKaO4PaXiQJlH5fu-cu5MY8LUENkIa3GkhPtkemWT1X9bomrs0COTTMCOov8ud2e4V2xlFgwr21yqM2dsUiVvUgJZgmVGVYYHT5V0N0NdueVrJA/4v7/ju7JjMZuQjyb-PI4HPqtSQ/h4/h001.VyqgeodlAiLKdib-l7eRpFvWhk3SHcl-vj69p6poQL0) My entire career has been spent protecting Americans. But career politicians like Mike Lawler are throwing that away, voting with Donald Trump 100% of the time and driving up prices. **That’s why I’m running for Congress. Because I won’t tolerate what’s happening to our country.** And with voters heading to the polls as we speak, I’m counting on your support right now, Peter. There are still serious budget needs that we need to meet if we want to win. [Please — if you can afford to make a donation of $10 to help us hit our goals, I hope you’ll donate today. Any amount makes a major difference in a race this competitive. Thank you in advance for your generous support.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqiBIysd_1t7dQL51NYrcynj_UHKTnEbFJuXRbcU0RusMeK8Uw0hMFlhZHdKfCOjyn-8fbiUvjghI0_OO5PRlpp5ZvbXwHIXy8uu8kYBd5hAOy1fOjolglWcp6OcOYpc0j3cSuMGPbT6rtLc4M_uS7Jbf16ocf9-en1qzMCQBo-SF-HfBWMzpV-qptQeIsD-FAadnceAflXaprtvzO3lYZz7GLr7Ppg3_OK30TvWWylpadzZVhTA2QgHbzMckf9blmNqSFS7UrOmq4HegMywB6lCejEi1q46obPwGkTz8s3g/4v7/ju7JjMZuQjyb-PI4HPqtSQ/h5/h001.gdHMnRwttEPgj1_hXbu61thbpd6kAeVQx26Wjf3PSuE) | If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process now.

| It’s Angie Nixon. They said we couldn’t win our primary when we were outspent 16-1, but we built a grassroots movement and proved that people power can beat big money. They say Florida is too red, that it’s too far gone to win. But they are wrong. A new public poll came out today, and it is shocking the establishment. It shows that our race is tied, 47-47. But it’s not shocking to me. And I’ll tell you why. I’ve been organizing in this state for decades, and I know when our people are fed up. Like folks all over the country, Floridians are tired of the rising cost of everything. But particularly in our state, we’ve been hit hard by skyrocketing insurance rates, high rents, and price gouging getting us behind. Our opponent is less popular than the President. And that’s not surprising either. She’s corrupt and signed off on a scheme to take government money away from healthcare for poor kids to fund political ads. She was appointed, not elected, to her seat to be a rubber stamp for her billionaire donors. I am doing my best to reach every corner of the state and go to places Democrats don’t often visit. We are mobilizing voters all over Florida who have been disenfranchised from our politics and are looking for someone who will stand up for them. This is the type of campaign we are running, and these are the results we are seeing. I know how to stretch a dollar, believe me. Right now, we are trying to fund our statewide field program and our first round of TV ads. [$5, $10, or even $25 goes a long way. This race is tied. It is on us to win it.](https://eboq88hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0018DAt-PD4YiLIpgPA13tCX8z_dVz4Laoe79OyBa8ng-U-ZGiESKF_Updh12JKPVidhc104id5DnLi1kA3AgGzT0ZoMc827-X1zVzO84x8I9bgpatUqkJH1eLxf7iQ7g2LUrdTd8_AWI3WYFDYLu2s-UuvTClRiStIxlfywsXbKCm9hb6N-BOQFaYtFW9kQSI3IClPQ00aBOybiFT9FNh4NDzOGKDxHqgg_5iKXTrJ1oDzu1VDyNT14Q==&c=aV_tIv81ItQAleCfK5u8k3rxQahIXM4wrEXIxcJJxDuSX320JFLoZA==&ch=P1cLSvfQqeWppYcm0lBA6nOjt26N1-o0XHzfWa0WSy-L2kw5B_89Xg==)

subject: Your continued support is what keeps me fighting.
body:

Ten years ago, I could never have imagined where I would be today.

Serving my second term as President of the United States of America. Leading a movement whose sole goal is to make our nation the Greatest in the world.

In 2016, you placed your faith in me, and through it all, you have never wavered.

**_Never broken._**

That’s why it is my greatest honor, every day, to be your President. I will never forget the trust you have bestowed upon me.

So today, I’m reaching out to you to make a promise, a solemn vow to the supporters that have been with me since the beginning.

They will stop at nothing to destroy what we have built. We cannot let them.

I promise to YOU, the American People, hand over heart:

We have fought every single day to create an America that our children, grandchildren, and great-grandchildren can be proud of, and defeat now is not an option.******

We CANNOT let that happen.

I’m asking you today with a humble heart, please keep your faith in me******

subject: A can of Diet Sun Drop
body:
Peter, it's go time.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1758&source=&t=1&akid=4975%2E124072%2EbPtwVf) | | | |
---
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1758&amount=5&t=8&akid=4975%2E124072%2EbPtwVf)
Peter, you might be a coffee fan. Or maybe you prefer tea. You might be all about sweet tea – especially if you live here in the South. **I’ll admit those drinks all have their place, but most of the time, I’d rather have my Diet Sun Drop.**
I’m drinking one as I write this, in fact. Diet Sun Drops have kept me caffeinated and ready to face long days on the campaign trail – and over the last two weeks, after President Trump and Vice President Vance both came to North Carolina for the second time to attack me, it’s clear that I was ready for an energy boost.
All levity aside, though, the stakes for this race couldn’t be higher, Peter. And with early voting underway and Election Day just around the corner, Trump and Vance coming to North Carolina could curb our momentum. **Vance is even returning this week to double down on his attacks.**
This race is going to come down to the wire, and the GOP is going all-in to prop up their MAGA puppet, Michael Whatley, right as voters are heading to the polls.
Peter, I’ve worn many hats in my life, from “diet soda sommelier” (a title I gave myself) to Governor of North Carolina. Now I’m ready for what might be the most important one: United States Senator. **Diet Sun Drops won’t get me there without you, though. I need the surge of grassroots support that people like you provide.
**If we lose this race, we lose the Senate majority. If that happens, we won’t be able to put a check on the Trump administration’s chaos and corruption. So please, I’m personally asking:[_Will you chip in $5 – or even just $1, the price of a can of Diet Sun Drop – to help me fight back against the GOP, fund our get-out-the-vote efforts and flip NC blue?_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1758&amount=5&t=9&akid=4975%2E124072%2EbPtwVf)**
| | [DONATE](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1758&amount=5&t=10&akid=4975%2E124072%2EbPtwVf)
---
Thanks for all your support.
Roy Cooper
_P.S. If you’ve never tried Diet Sun Drop, pick one up the next time you’re at the store. Because I’m telling you ... it’s delicious._
| |
* * *
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1758&t=2&akid=4975%2E124072%2EbPtwVf)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

Hi team,
My family has lived in our part of PA for ten generations. They taught me the Pennsylvania Dutch values that shaped who I am today:
**Work hard, show up for people when they need it, and never say no to a beer or a pretzel.**
[ CHIP IN](https://substack.com/redirect/07c19163-f9dd-44e7-bc45-46bb4727ffd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Those values are why I'm running for Congress.
Our part of Pennsylvania is struggling right now - and I see it. But I don't see Dan Meuser doing anything about it. Instead he has doubled his net worth in office.
**I want to fight for us.** Not a political party, not my own bank account, but for us and our priorities and our communities. And I understand that that can be hard to believe because we have been sold out over and over again.
But like a lot of us here, I was raised to pick up trash when you see it, to fill up the gas tank after you borrow someone's car, and to leave things better than when you found it.
**Our part of PA knows what that looks like. And we know we don 't see it in Dan Meuser.**
**[We have a once-in-a-generation opportunity to flip this seat and make real change. If you 're with me, will you chip in today to power us through the final stretch?](https://substack.com/redirect/07c19163-f9dd-44e7-bc45-46bb4727ffd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[DONATE NOW](https://substack.com/redirect/07c19163-f9dd-44e7-bc45-46bb4727ffd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
From here, for here, no matter what.
Gratefully,
Rachel Wallace 🍻🥨

View in Web Browser
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e15773891/UaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvTmhNZ2ZnZVVoVA/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjEwMjY/LbmNseDFCdHlyNA/qP2hpZHM9bmMxRG9oNHpwY3laS0Vsc10/gat_Sbw/s4mb6ceaba1

Early Vote Action

Patriot,

Here’s the plain truth they don’t want you to see: a pollster was
just caught admitting it fabricated its survey results — and some
candidates say those fake numbers killed their campaigns.

That’s not a one-off. It’s the whole playbook. Fake polls, rigged
prediction markets, and wall-to-wall doom coverage, all aimed at one

Republicans see a first-term seat as their best chance to take it back. They’ve made CA-45 one of their top targets, and they’re watching to see whether the coalition that elected me shows up again. | | | Fellow American, We’re in the FINAL few days of the election – and we need to be brutally honest about where we stand. Here’s the hard pill to swallow... **James Talarico has raised TWICE as much money than my Democrat opponent did during my last election._That’s right – DOUBLE._****_ _** With twice as much money, Talarico can reach twice as many voters, run twice as many ads, hire twice as many staffers, and power twice the size of a get-out-the-vote operation. _You can thank Attorney General Paxton for upholding the ban on ballot harvesting in Texas or else Talarico would certainly be harvesting twice as many ballots!__ _ Now here comes the gut punch. _Colin Allred only raised about _10% more money_ than I did..._** ** **_But Talarico has raised _560%_ more than our fearless Attorney General._** So, at the final hour, I’m helping push Ken Paxton past the finish line with all I’ve got. This is a David vs. Goliath showdown. And it’s time to pull out my secret weapon... _YOU_. clean_body: Friend, My name is Emily, and I'm a ballot chaser for Turning Point PAC in Arizona. That means every day, I show up, knock on doors, have conversations with potential voters, and chase down ballots before Election Day. I need to tell you what I'm seeing out here, because I don't think most people understand how close this really is. Arizona is not lost.Not even close. But it is not safe either. A new poll just showed Katie Hobbs up by 4 points over Andy Biggs. Four points. That is the entire ballgame, sitting right there behind the doors I have not knocked on yet. Turning Point PAC is not like anything else in this space. They take decades of grassroots organizing and put real people, like me, into these communities well before Election Day. We build relationships. We knock on the same doors more than once. We chase every ballot, mail-in or in person, because every single one counts. This is the vision Charlie Kirk built. People on the ground, having real conversations, changing real minds. And it is working! But I cannot do this alone, and neither can the 700 of us out here across Arizona. I 'm seeing momentum on the ground, but we have so many more voters to cover. We can't do it without your continued support. Every $50 you give sponsors a ballot chaser like me for one full day. That's about 75 doors and 25 real conversations with voters who haven't made up their minds yet, and who deserve to hear from us before it's too late. body:
Scott Colom has the momentum. He just needs resources.
| | |
---
Friend, in this final week before the midterms, I have one important reminder: **Do not write off the South!**

As I walked side-by-side with French Antifa down the streets of Porte de Vincennes in Paris, my nose and eyes started to burn.
I looked up and saw big white clouds on the horizon where police had set up a shield wall blocking the street. **[It was tear gas.](https://substack.com/redirect/ecbf8a57-8db0-42a0-afbf-2eb7e5bbf8c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Loud bangs thundered in the distance toward the police line.
## [Watch what happened: ](https://substack.com/redirect/ecbf8a57-8db0-42a0-afbf-2eb7e5bbf8c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

My colleague and I ran through the crowd toward the clouds and noise. This is what we came for: to document the riots that have been scourging France for the past several weeks and find out what is really motivating them.
As we approached the police line we captured this moment, an Antifa militant in Black Bloc climbing onto a car and shooting fireworks directly at police officers as the crowd went wild with cheers and shouts.

The French apparently do this all the time. It's alarmingly normal for them to watch a revolt in the street with a glass of beer and a cig, like a spectator sport.
I was praying to the Lord Almighty to keep me and my team safe as we tried our best to document the day's events.
We feared we were being trapped in the city block for imminent arrest as riot police closed in. There was nowhere to escape. But those around us did not look phased. We realized that the bystanders observing from the sidewalk were not considered police targets, and were seen as non-participants as the riot police walked right past us to pursue others who were actively throwing objects. We were out of bounds in the game that was playing out between the 2 sides, and thankfully we were not arrested.
Earlier in the day, at Porte d'Italie, we spoke to protesters about their grievances and what their true intentions are.
Long story short, these are unapologetic communists using the student protest as a catalyst for revolution.
I plan to write more about the experience in detail this week, so stay tuned and thank you for your support. We couldn't do this kind of ground journalism without the amazing support of our paid subscribers here on Substack.

As we inch closer to Election Day, it feels like every day there’s a new headline on Trump’s relentless attempts to rig the midterms.

Whether it’s threatening to send ICE agents to polling sites, directing the USPS to shut down vote-by-mail, or suing states to obtain classified voter information, it’s _non-stop._

The Department of Justice even took Kentucky to court just months ago in an attempt to steal sensitive, confidential voters’ information from our voter registration database.

I understand many fear for the state of our democracy. I, frankly, do too. But I want to highlight the silver lining in all of this.

**Trump is rigging the game because he knows if he plays by the rules, he will lose – by a lot.** [](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/18398?source=SL_EM_FR_2026.10.26_Booker-Fate_B3_F1_S1_C1_180AC-360DON_T1&t=4&akid=3770%2E259176%2Ens195k) The polls speak for themselves. The people are waking up. Trump once promised to drain the swamp, but every day it becomes clearer that _he is_ the swamp.

That’s why people who have never voted have pledged to vote for me. That’s why people who campaigned for Trump are now campaigning for me.

We can take back the Senate, rebuild our democracy, and fight Trump’s agenda. My Trump-endorsed opponent, however, plans to fast-track it. clean_body: Everything is on the line | | Friend, This is one of the last times you will hear from me before the votes are counted, so let me make it count. I did not get here alone. Every door we knocked, every ad we ran, every stand we took against the radical left, we did together, because people like you believed North Texas was worth fighting for. Now we are down to the final hours, the House hangs by a thread, and the radical left is favored to take it. Everything is on the line. I am asking you to do the same, one last time. | | Whatever happens, thank you for standing with me. Let's finish this the right way. | | Beth Van Duyne ---|--- | PAID FOR BY BETH VAN DUYNE FOR CONGRESS

Early Vote Action

Patriot, Let me explain why I'm so fired up about ballot chasing -- because the math is beautiful. Every Republican vote we "bank" early frees campaigns to stop chasing that voter and focus everything on turning out the people who haven't voted yet. Bank 20,000 votes early, and the path to victory gets dramatically easier. And study after study shows there's nothing more effective than a knock on the door. That's what my team does -- using daily data to find who has a ballot and sending activists to make sure it gets returned. Chasing ballots = banking votes. The more chasers you help fund, the more races we win.

Peter, it's Michele Tafoya.

I've been on the road a lot recently, pressed for time, hopping from one city to the next, but I still wanted to take some time out of my day to write to you.I didn't waste time sending this to my team for final review; I wanted to get this over to you as soon as I possibly could.

If you've been following what's happening in Minnesota, here's where we're at now:
1. The latest polls now have me and my Far Left opponent, Peggy Flanagan, DEAD EVEN in the home stretch. Voters are clearly demanding change.
2. My campaign has been surging past our expectations thanks to thousands of grassroots patriots like you chipping in just $5 or $10 whenever they can (contrary to my socialist opponent's wealthy boosters).
3. The Democrat political machine has invested thousands in bogus attack ads in Minnesota against me because they're terrified of us pulling off the upset.

It's clear now, more than ever, that the tides are turning in our direction. I wanted to show you, in these points above, some of the fruits of all of our hard work together.
__But the final buzzer still hasn 't sounded, and you don't get a prize for winning the 3rd quarter when there's plenty of time left in the game!__
I've seen first-hand PLENTY of teams who think they've got the win in the bag take their foot off the gas and go on defense... all to face defeat right before the clock hits zero.
**We won 't be that team.**
If anything, we're itching to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat. We've known since the start of this movement that we're the clear underdog in this race.
But we're FAR from throwing in the towel.
Now that we're in the home stretch, your direct support to me and this movement becomes even more important.
Truth be told, it'd be a disaster if we lost you, Peter.

It’s Martin Sheen. After more than half a century as an actor, I know a thing or two about a good story.
Josh Turek, Iowa’s next U.S. Senator, has a story like no other.
I’ll get to that shortly. But first I have a message, not as an actor, but as a fellow patriot.
Iowa’s open Senate seat is Democrats’ ticket to retaking the Senate and protecting our Constitution for generations to come. This is not a race _any of us_ can watch from the sidelines.
Josh has the strength, the skill, and support to win, but he doesn’t accept money from corporate pacs. Most of you know me as President Bartlet from The West Wing. But many years before my term as TV president, I was in a film called Apocalypse Now.
For those of you who haven’t seen it, Apocalypse Now follows an American soldier on a journey up the rivers of Vietnam. It’s a story all about the horrors of a war that still affects us to this day.
_The Turek family knows that firsthand._
Josh Turek’s father, John, joined the Navy on his 18th birthday. He served in Vietnam for 22 months, but the effects of war lingered with him long after he returned home.
His son, Josh, was born with spina bifida caused by Agent Orange exposure. Josh underwent 21 painful surgeries as a young boy, dealt with terrible bullying, and struggled to navigate life in a wheelchair.
Through sheer will, he became a celebrated athlete in wheelchair basketball, winning a scholarship, playing professionally, and even taking home two gold medals for Team USA at the Paralympics.
Next, Josh decided to give politics a shot. He served two successful terms in the Iowa State House before launching his United States Senate campaign last year.
Now, Josh is the Democratic nominee for the Senate seat currently held by Joni Ernst, and is tied with his Republican opponent in the polls.
**That’s one heck of a story, don’t you agree?**

**A note from Dr. Jasser**

# **WE CAN WIN THIS**

The Democratic Party's ‘psy-op’ to try and demoralize Americans has run out of steam and is now colliding with reality. We will shock the world! There are **8 days left** to help join us in — expecting the unexpected! We're going to show the world that the forces of freedom are stronger than the false seduction of socialism. We are going to show the world that we truly are THE LAND OF THE FREE AND THE HOME OF THE BRAVE! Arizona’s District 4 is a microcosm of all that.
Every day, I meet Republicans, independents, and Democrats who are tired of the same partisan fights and ready for a common-sense voice in Washington. There's been a lazy assumption that because Greg Stanton has been elected before, he will be elected again. And to that I say, “Nonsense”! Frankly, I’ve never seen a candidate more complacent and entitled than Greg. He truly seems to believe that the seat is _his_ rather than his _constituents_ ’. I’m fighting for them, and I’m fighting for you. We cannot let someone else’s prediction convince us to sit this one out.
We have a fiercely independent district that wants something new, something authentic. This is our moment!
So if you’ve given, please give more. And if you’ve prayed, please pray more. Victory is in our sights. Let’s claim it! **Make your plan to vote on or before November 3.** Then call a friend, remind a neighbor, and help us RETIRE Stanton! We have a chance to push back against socialism and extreme partisanship and bring common sense to AZ-04. Make your voice heard and VOTE!

Dr. Zuhdi Jasser

body:
and the Radical Democrats want to spend more
---
| | | | | | [](https://cgnb9.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsDg0cEbC62mBi3KJrKWON/q3m6HcK_YcL4)

| Friends,
The Democrats’ open-border agenda has a $613 billion price tag—and hardworking taxpayers are the ones who will be forced to pay it.
---
| [](https://cgnb9.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsE8LKR1aS8hLy79hgJG6R/BMEqLpUvWHuJ)
---
_**[_**I just published an op-ed in The Washington Times that every American needs to read.**_](https://cgnb9.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsEag2dRyoEcWEAz5VHzoV/EWkIA91Ua-bu)**_
_**The radical immigration policies pushed by the Democratic Socialists of America and embraced by today’s Democrat Party would cost America between $440 billion and $613 billion over the next decade.**_
That’s real money. Your money!
Here’s the truth:

* _Illegal aliens cost American taxpayers an average of $166,716 over a lifetime._
* _Granting amnesty would explode costs for food stamps, housing, and Medicaid by $36–47 billion every single year._
* _Ending the strong enforcement we’ve put in place would erase $227–287 billion in projected savings._

Under President Trump, we’ve secured the border. Nearly 17 straight months of zero releases. Crime is down and 2.5 million illegal aliens have left the country. **Those are real results - and real savings for the American people.**
DSA Democrats want to reverse every bit of that progress. They want open borders, mass amnesty, and your tax dollars footing the bill.
I will not let that happen.
[**I’m fighting every day in Congress to protect American families, secure our border, and stop this radical agenda.** ](https://cgnb9.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsF30kpsNAKXgUEoTKGjWZ/twbmw6j_1O7P)
But I need you standing with me.
| [ADD MY NAME: NO MORE TAX DOLLARS FOR ILLEGALS](https://cgnb9.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsFVLT2IlWQSqkIdr9FTEd/EbB636UOWN8c)
---
We cannot go back to the chaos of open borders. We will not stick hardworking Americans with the illegal-alien bill.
Thank you for standing with me.
For America,
| [](https://cgnb9.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsFxgBEj9sWO10MTEyECwh/dNoZ_7FvkOLE)
---
**Sheri Biggs****Endorsed by President Donald J. Trump****
****[**P.S. Read my full op-ed in The Washington Times and then add your name today. The radical left is already preparing to undo everything we’ve accomplished. We must act now.**](https://cgnb9.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsGQ0tR9YEcJBGQIcnCwel/FzFIORFY4P0k)**

Election forecasters shifted the race in favor of my Republican opponent. We were being outspent to the tune of $2 million! The last minute infusion of resources from supporters like you is why we won that race. **So now I’m asking on behalf of five fellow Democratic scientists who are in the same position.** [Polling has each of their races within the margin of error. Can I count on you to split a donation directly between Manny Rutinel, Elaine Luria, Amish Shah, Christina Bohannan, Rebecca Bennett, and my campaign today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142247746/656283873/1391480790?refcode=10.26.26-es-email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZGI5NWFkYy05M2QxLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Luf-avB5RJa18X_mSdm-DdpkD7w7A_gm2x9VEEtxBYM=) | **Manny Rutinel (CO-8)** is an environmental attorney, microbiologist, and former State Representative who served with the Army Corps of Engineers to provide aid to Americans during crises, including in Puerto Rico during Hurricane Maria in 2017. Now, he’s running for a district that Democrats **won by 1% of the vote in 2022 and lost by less than 1% of the vote in 2024.** Manny is currently being outspent by **$2 million** by GOP outside groups. **Latest Polling: Rutinel (D): 46% – Evans (R): 48%**

**Elaine Luria (VA-2)** is a nuclear engineer, Navy Veteran, and former Representative who was among the first Navy women to spend her career aboard combatant ships and was one of the first women to graduate from the Navy’s nuclear power program. After her service, she **flipped a safe GOP seat blue by 2% in 2018.** The Washington Post distinguished VA-2 as the **“signature bellwether district” of the midterms** and Elaine is currently up against **$3.1 million** in GOP dark money spending. **Latest Polling: Luria (D): 47% – Kiggans (R): 47%**
---
**Dr. Amish Shah (AZ-1)** is an ER physician, former State Representative, and pilot who has flown himself across the state to treat patients in underserved communities. During his 5 years in the State House, he passed the most bipartisan bills into law than any Democrat in Arizona history. Last cycle, Amish ran and came just **3% short of flipping AZ-1,** which is now an open GOP-held seat. Amish is currently being outspent by nearly **$2.1 million** by GOP outside groups. **Latest Polling: Shah (D): 44% – Feely (R): 42%**
---
**Christina Bohannan (IA-1)** is an environmental engineer, law professor, and former State Representative running to flip what RollCall has designated as the **best flip opportunity for Democrats on the House map.** Last cycle, Christina ran and fell just **0.2% short of flipping IA-1, the closest margin of victory of any House Republican in 2024.** Christina is currently being outspent by **$1.8 million** by GOP outside groups. **Latest Polling: Bohannan (D): 43% – Miller-Meeks (R): 39%**
---
**Rebecca Bennett (NJ-7)** is a chemical engineer and former Navy helicopter pilot and aircraft commander of 15 years in the armed forces who made history as only the 18th woman to become a Naval test pilot. Now, she’s running as a first-time candidate in a district that Donald Trump only **won by 1%** and one that Democrat Mikie Sherrill carried by just **2%** last year. Rebecca is currently being outspent by nearly **$2.5 million** by GOP outside groups. **Latest Polling: Bennett (D): 47% – Kean Jr. (R): 43%**

Peter,

When I stood on stage at our rally in Bakersfield with AOC this past weekend, I kept thinking about how many times I’d been told that people like me can’t win here.

I’ve heard it for years from folks who assume working families here don’t vote, and who told me that if I wanted to win, I’d have to soften my positions on health care and corporate money and run like every other politician who’s let this Valley down.

They said the same thing during the primary, right up until we beat more than $4 million in super PAC spending to win it.

But the hundreds of neighbors who showed up to our rally know better.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142247834/656284104/1733485175?refcode=em-10.26.26-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWU0ZDRkMzQtOTRkMS1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjlmODY5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=l6F0Qr65oYB6vyfqTTmeV-DWlZ10QLaxpskF8rgT__M=)
We know what it costs a family when their congressman votes to gut the Medicaid their neighbors depend on, and we know that good health care and a real shot at a decent future shouldn’t be reserved for people who can afford a lobbyist.

When AOC told the crowd that “our future is not David Valadao,” she was putting words to something this district already feels. This is one of the youngest districts in the country, and the next generation deserves a representative who answers to them instead of to the corporate donors who have kept a stranglehold on our community for too long.

Valadao and his allies have always counted on us believing we can’t win, and they’re spending massive sums to keep us convinced. With ballots already in mailboxes and Election Day eight days away, we have one last chance to prove them wrong again.

clean_body: | = Peter, When I stood on stage at our rally in Bakersfield with AOC this past weekend, I kept thinking about how many times I’d been told that people like me can’t win here. I’ve heard it for years from folks who assume working families here don’t vote, and who told me that if I wanted to win, I’d have to soften my positions on health care and corporate money and run like every other politician who’s let this Valley down. They said the same thing during the primary, right up until we beat more than $4 million in super PAC spending to win it. But the hundreds of neighbors who showed up to our rally know better. = We know what it costs a family when their congressman votes to gut the Medicaid their neighbors depend on, and we know that good health care and a real shot at a decent future shouldn’t be reserved for people who can afford a lobbyist. When AOC told the crowd that “our future is not David Valadao,” she was putting words to something this district already feels. This is one of the youngest districts in the country, and the next generation deserves a representative who answers to them instead of to the corporate donors who have kept a stranglehold on our community for too long. Valadao and his allies have always counted on us believing we can’t win, and they’re spending massive sums to keep us convinced. With ballots already in mailboxes and Election Day eight days away, we have one last chance to prove them wrong again. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Randy | With deep ties to our community and a lifelong commitment to justice and equity, Randy is running for Congress in California’s 22nd District to bring bold, compassionate leadership to Washington. Hey there, I know my team has been reaching out a lot lately, and I hate to pile on — but I’m throwing a Hail Mary here. I just took a look at our fundraising numbers for the month so far, and unless we see a big boost in donations from your area, we’re at _severe_ risk of falling short of our October projections. Here’s the thing: Falling short of _some_ fundraising goals isn’t the end of the world. I’ve seen what this grassroots team is able to accomplish, and I have faith in our ability to recover from tough setbacks.
But with just eight days to go until Election Day, the stakes are only getting higher.
I’ve said it once, and I’ll say it again: [**The road to flipping the House blue runs through OR-06.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142248003/656284795/1477985144?refcode=email_102626_hailmary-rs2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhN2E4OGMyZS05NWQxLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyOWY4NjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eTxb6zq_fC_B8iHwlWQ3g2b-SrhT-XxSNIWfHm7J0ts=)
If we don’t defend this seat, that means two more years of unchecked Republican rule, two more years of higher costs, and two more years of leadership that puts politics and their wallets above working families.
And if our opponent catches wind of the fact that we’re falling behind? You better believe they’ll use that to try to flip this seat.

| | Dear Friend, Let’s be honest: politics feels exhausting right now. The ads, the headlines, the sense that everyone in Washington is more interested in winning a fight than solving a problem.

This election is about something simple: **whether people in northern and central Minnesota can build a good life here**.

Whether there’s a doctor close to home when you need one.
Whether the lakes and woods we love will still be here for generations to enjoy.
Whether you can afford to heat your house, fill your tank, and keep food on the table.

None of those are Republican or Democratic problems. They’re our problems and they deserve a representative who puts people ahead of party.

Trina Swanson is running for Congress for that very reason. Over the past months, she’s held town halls across this district, open to everyone, and she’s listened to people of every political viewpoint. Some agreed with her, some didn’t - all of them deserved to be heard.

She brings 25 years of public service to the job and you don’t have to agree with Trina on everything to know she’ll show up, listen, and work with anyone willing to get something done.That’s what this is all about. Not a party. Not a slogan. **You, your family, and the place we call home**.

Early voting is open now, and Election Day is Tuesday, November 3rd.Let’s get something done together. Vote Trina Swanson for Congress.

subject: SCOTUS just ruled against NH students
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
The Supreme Court just handed Republicans a major win in New Hampshire.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=9797%2E582294%2Ej7pL3h)
Friend,
We’ll get right to the point: With only 8 days until Election Day, **the Supreme Court just handed Republicans a major win in New Hampshire.**
**[We’re asking you to rush $5 to Chris Pappas’s campaign right now to protect our democracy and help flip the Senate blue.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261026_4.T_JVId&refcode=em20261026-4&t=2&akid=9797%2E582294%2Ej7pL3h)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261026_4.T_JVId&amount=5&refcode=em20261026-4&t=3&akid=9797%2E582294%2Ej7pL3h)**
Here’s what happened:
The Court sided with the Republican National Committee and New Hampshire Republicans, **ruling that election officials can fully bar student IDs from being used to help verify a voter’s identity at the polls.** A federal judge had said the state went too far. The Supreme Court erased that protection, citing the danger of changing rules close to an election.
**_Make no mistake: This ruling makes it harder for students to vote, and Republicans fought for it because they’re scared they will lose._**
Here’s why it matters so much in New Hampshire: There is no early voting. In the last midterm, about 90% of voters cast their ballots in person on Election Day.
That means a student turned away at the polls on November 3rd doesn’t get another chance.
Chris is running against John Sununu in one of the most competitive and expensive Senate races in America. And New Hampshire has one of the largest college student populations per capita in the country. Republicans know that.

| | Early last year, I sounded the alarm on the proliferation of Flock cameras and the threat they pose to our constitutional right to privacy. Since then, there's been an explosion of new Flock cameras across the country and reports of law enforcement abusing its access to this data. Here are some of the reported abuses: law enforcement officers using the technology to stalk ex-girlfriends, trace women going out of state for reproductive care if they live in a state with an abortion ban, and ICE officers using the data to track immigrants. Every single American has a constitutional right to privacy. The right to live your life without fear of the government tracking where you go, who you talk to, and what you do. The proliferation of Flock cameras poses one of the single biggest threats to Americans' privacy today. All of us deserve to live in a country to not be surveilled by the state, have their data sold to the highest bidder, be tracked illegally by their government across state lines, _or_ have their information used by law enforcement for reasons outside of enforcing the law. All of which are things that have been documented to happen under the "watchful eye" of Flock. **These are weapons of mass inspection, plain and simple.** As the Senate's resident "privacy hawk," I've made it my mission to sound the alarm and tackle Flock's privacy abuses head on.
